AIMed.d58.s511.orig_sentence: A cDNA clone encoding a novel, widely expressed protein (called growth factor receptor-bound protein 2 or GRB2) containing one src homology 2 (SH2) domain and two SH3 domains was isolated.

AIMed.d58.s512.sentence: Immunoblotting experiments indicate that PROTEIN0 associates with tyrosine-phosphorylated epidermal growth factor receptors (EGFRs) and platelet-derived growth factor receptors (PDGFRs) via its SH2 domain.
AIMed.d58.s512.orig_sentence: Immunoblotting experiments indicate that GRB2 associates with tyrosine-phosphorylated epidermal growth factor receptors (EGFRs) and platelet-derived growth factor receptors (PDGFRs) via its SH2 domain.

AIMed.d58.s513.sentence: Interestingly, PROTEIN0 exhibits striking structural and functional homology to the C. elegans protein sem-5.
AIMed.d58.s513.orig_sentence: Interestingly, GRB2 exhibits striking structural and functional homology to the C. elegans protein sem-5.

AIMed.d58.s514.sentence: It has been shown that sem-5 and two other genes called let-23 (EGFR like) and let-60 (ras like) lie along the same signal transduction pathway controlling C. elegans vulval induction.
AIMed.d58.s514.orig_sentence: It has been shown that sem-5 and two other genes called let-23 (EGFR like) and let-60 (ras like) lie along the same signal transduction pathway controlling C. elegans vulval induction.

AIMed.d58.s515.sentence: To examine whether PROTEIN0 is also a component of ras signaling in mammalian cells, microinjection studies were performed.
AIMed.d58.s515.orig_sentence: To examine whether GRB2 is also a component of ras signaling in mammalian cells, microinjection studies were performed.

AIMed.d58.s516.sentence: While injection of PROTEIN0 or PROTEIN1 proteins alone into quiescent rat fibroblasts did not have mitogenic effect, microinjection of PROTEIN2 together with PROTEIN3 protein stimulated DNA synthesis.
AIMed.d58.s516.orig_sentence: While injection of GRB2 or H-ras proteins alone into quiescent rat fibroblasts did not have mitogenic effect, microinjection of GRB2 together with H-ras protein stimulated DNA synthesis.

AIMed.d58.s517.sentence: These results suggest that PROTEIN0/PROTEIN1 plays a crucial role in a highly conserved mechanism for growth factor control of ras signaling.
AIMed.d58.s517.orig_sentence: These results suggest that GRB2/sem-5 plays a crucial role in a highly conserved mechanism for growth factor control of ras signaling.

AIMed.d59.s518.sentence: Analysis of the oligomerization of PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 products in vivo using a two-hybrid assay system.
AIMed.d59.s518.orig_sentence: Analysis of the oligomerization of myogenin and E2A products in vivo using a two-hybrid assay system.

AIMed.d59.s519.sentence: Members of the helix-loop-helix (HLH) family of proteins bind DNA and activate transcription as homo- and heterodimers.
AIMed.d59.s519.orig_sentence: Members of the helix-loop-helix (HLH) family of proteins bind DNA and activate transcription as homo- and heterodimers.

AIMed.d59.s520.sentence: PROTEIN0 is a muscle-specific HLH protein that binds DNA in vitro as a heterodimer with several widely expressed HLH proteins, such as the PROTEIN1 gene products PROTEIN2 and PROTEIN3.
AIMed.d59.s520.orig_sentence: Myogenin is a muscle-specific HLH protein that binds DNA in vitro as a heterodimer with several widely expressed HLH proteins, such as the E2A gene products E12 and E47.

AIMed.d59.s521.sentence: We describe a method for detection of protein-protein interactions among HLH proteins in vivo in which dimerization through the HLH motif reconstructs a hybrid transcription factor containing the DNA-binding domain of yeast GAL4 linked to one HLH motif and the activation domain of PROTEIN0 linked to another.
AIMed.d59.s521.orig_sentence: We describe a method for detection of protein-protein interactions among HLH proteins in vivo in which dimerization through the HLH motif reconstructs a hybrid transcription factor containing the DNA-binding domain of yeast GAL4 linked to one HLH motif and the activation domain of VP-16 linked to another.

AIMed.d59.s522.sentence: We have used this assay to investiagate whether myogenin forms homomeric or heteromeric complexes in vivo and to determine whether growth factors and oncogenes that inhibit myogenesis influence myogenin's ability to dimerize.
AIMed.d59.s522.orig_sentence: We have used this assay to investiagate whether myogenin forms homomeric or heteromeric complexes in vivo and to determine whether growth factors and oncogenes that inhibit myogenesis influence myogenin's ability to dimerize.

AIMed.d59.s523.sentence: The results show that PROTEIN0 heterodimerizes with PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2 in vivo, but it does not homodimerize to a measurable extent.
AIMed.d59.s523.orig_sentence: The results show that myogenin heterodimerizes with E12 and E47 in vivo, but it does not homodimerize to a measurable extent.

AIMed.d59.s524.sentence: Peptide growth factors, as well as the immediate early gene products PROTEIN0, PROTEIN1, and PROTEIN2, inhibit the activity of myogenin through a mechanism independent of its association with PROTEIN3 products.
AIMed.d59.s524.orig_sentence: Peptide growth factors, as well as the immediate early gene products c-Jun, v-Fos, and c-Myc, inhibit the activity of myogenin through a mechanism independent of its association with E2A products.

AIMed.d60.s525.sentence: Activation of PROTEIN0 PROTEIN1 by PROTEIN2 in NIH 3T3 cells and in vitro.
AIMed.d60.s525.orig_sentence: Activation of mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase by v-Raf in NIH 3T3 cells and in vitro.

AIMed.d60.s526.sentence: Mitogen-activated protein (MAP) kinases are 42- and 44-kD serine-threonine protein kinases that are activated by tyrosine and threonine phosphorylation in cells stimulated with mitogens and growth factors.
AIMed.d60.s526.orig_sentence: Mitogen-activated protein (MAP) kinases are 42- and 44-kD serine-threonine protein kinases that are activated by tyrosine and threonine phosphorylation in cells stimulated with mitogens and growth factors.

AIMed.d60.s527.sentence: PROTEIN0 and the protein kinase that activates it (PROTEIN1) were constitutively activated in NIH 3T3 cells infected with viruses containing either of two oncogenic forms (p35EC12, p3722W) of the PROTEIN2 protein kinase.
AIMed.d60.s527.orig_sentence: MAP kinase and the protein kinase that activates it (MAP kinase kinase) were constitutively activated in NIH 3T3 cells infected with viruses containing either of two oncogenic forms (p35EC12, p3722W) of the c-Raf-1 protein kinase.

AIMed.d60.s528.sentence: The PROTEIN0 proteins purified from cells infected with EC12 or 22W viruses activated PROTEIN1 PROTEIN2 from skeletal muscle in vitro.
AIMed.d60.s528.orig_sentence: The v-Raf proteins purified from cells infected with EC12 or 22W viruses activated MAP kinase kinase from skeletal muscle in vitro.

AIMed.d60.s529.sentence: Furthermore, a bacterially expressed PROTEIN0 fusion protein (glutathione S-transferase-p3722W) also activated PROTEIN1 PROTEIN2 in vitro.
AIMed.d60.s529.orig_sentence: Furthermore, a bacterially expressed v-Raf fusion protein (glutathione S-transferase-p3722W) also activated MAP kinase kinase in vitro.

AIMed.d60.s530.sentence: These findings suggest that one function of PROTEIN0 in mitogenic signaling is to phosphorylate and activate PROTEIN1 PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d60.s530.orig_sentence: These findings suggest that one function of c-Raf-1 in mitogenic signaling is to phosphorylate and activate MAP kinase kinase.

AIMed.d61.s531.sentence: Biochemical properties of the 75-kDa tumor necrosis factor receptor. Characterization of ligand binding, internalization, and receptor phosphorylation.
AIMed.d61.s531.orig_sentence: Biochemical properties of the 75-kDa tumor necrosis factor receptor. Characterization of ligand binding, internalization, and receptor phosphorylation.

AIMed.d61.s532.sentence: An expression plasmid encoding the human 75-kDa PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1) was constructed and used to generate a stable human cell line (293/PROTEIN2) overexpressing PROTEIN3.
AIMed.d61.s532.orig_sentence: An expression plasmid encoding the human 75-kDa tumor necrosis factor (TNF) type 2 receptor (TNF-R2) was constructed and used to generate a stable human cell line (293/TNF-R2) overexpressing TNF-R2.

AIMed.d61.s533.sentence: Ligand binding analysis revealed high affinity binding (Kd = 0.2 nM) with approximately 94,000 +/- 7,500 sites/cell for 125I-PROTEIN0 and approximately 5-fold lower affinity for PROTEIN1 (Kd = 1.1 nM) with 264,000 +/- 2,000 sites/cell.
AIMed.d61.s533.orig_sentence: Ligand binding analysis revealed high affinity binding (Kd = 0.2 nM) with approximately 94,000 +/- 7,500 sites/cell for 125I-TNF-alpha and approximately 5-fold lower affinity for TNF-beta (Kd = 1.1 nM) with 264,000 +/- 2,000 sites/cell.

AIMed.d61.s534.sentence: Cross-linking of 125I-PROTEIN0 and 125I-PROTEIN1 to 293/PROTEIN2 cells yielded predominant complexes with apparent molecular weights of 211,000 for PROTEIN3 and 205,000 and 244,000 for PROTEIN4, suggesting these complexes contain two or three PROTEIN5 molecules.
AIMed.d61.s534.orig_sentence: Cross-linking of 125I-TNF-alpha and 125I-TNF-beta to 293/TNF-R2 cells yielded predominant complexes with apparent molecular weights of 211,000 for TNF-alpha and 205,000 and 244,000 for TNF-beta, suggesting these complexes contain two or three TNF-R2 molecules.

AIMed.d61.s535.sentence: Immunoprecipitation of PROTEIN0 from 32P-labeled 293/PROTEIN1 cells demonstrated that the receptor is phosphorylated.
AIMed.d61.s535.orig_sentence: Immunoprecipitation of TNF-R2 from 32P-labeled 293/TNF-R2 cells demonstrated that the receptor is phosphorylated.

AIMed.d61.s536.sentence: The majority (97%) of 32Pi incorporation was found in serine residues with a very low level of incorporation (3%) in threonine residues.
AIMed.d61.s536.orig_sentence: The majority (97%) of 32Pi incorporation was found in serine residues with a very low level of incorporation (3%) in threonine residues.

AIMed.d61.s537.sentence: PROTEIN0 treatment of 293/PROTEIN1 cells did not significantly affect the degree or pattern of phosphorylation.
AIMed.d61.s537.orig_sentence: TNF-alpha treatment of 293/TNF-R2 cells did not significantly affect the degree or pattern of phosphorylation.

AIMed.d61.s538.sentence: Cell surface-bound 125I-TNF-alpha was slowly internalized by the 293/PROTEIN0 cell line with a t1/2 = 25 min.
AIMed.d61.s538.orig_sentence: Cell surface-bound 125I-TNF-alpha was slowly internalized by the 293/TNF-R2 cell line with a t1/2 = 25 min.

AIMed.d61.s539.sentence: Shedding of the extracellular domain of PROTEIN0 was induced by 4 beta-phorbol 12-myristate 13-acetate but not by PROTEIN1 or PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d61.s539.orig_sentence: Shedding of the extracellular domain of TNF-R2 was induced by 4 beta-phorbol 12-myristate 13-acetate but not by TNF-alpha or TNF-beta.

AIMed.d63.s544.sentence: Coassociation of PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1) with PROTEIN2 on the surface of human T lymphocytes.
AIMed.d63.s544.orig_sentence: Coassociation of CD26 (dipeptidyl peptidase IV) with CD45 on the surface of human T lymphocytes.

AIMed.d63.s545.sentence: In the present report, we demonstrated that modulation of PROTEIN0 from T cell surface induced by anti PROTEIN1 (1F7) led to enhanced phosphorylation of PROTEIN2 zeta tyrosine residues and increased PROTEIN3 associated p56lck tyrosine kinase activity.
AIMed.d63.s545.orig_sentence: In the present report, we demonstrated that modulation of CD26 from T cell surface induced by antiCD26 (1F7) led to enhanced phosphorylation of CD3 zeta tyrosine residues and increased CD4 associated p56lck tyrosine kinase activity.

AIMed.d63.s546.sentence: We further showed that PROTEIN0 was comodulated on the T cell surface with PROTEIN1, a known membrane-linked protein tyrosine phosphatase and that anti-PROTEIN2 was capable of precipitating PROTEIN3 from T cell lysates.
AIMed.d63.s546.orig_sentence: We further showed that CD26 was comodulated on the T cell surface with CD45, a known membrane-linked protein tyrosine phosphatase and that anti-CD26 was capable of precipitating CD45 from T cell lysates.

AIMed.d63.s547.sentence: These findings strongly suggest that PROTEIN0 may be closely associated with the PROTEIN1 protein tyrosine phosphatase on T cell surface and further support the notion that the interaction of PROTEIN2 with PROTEIN3 results in enhanced tyrosine kinase activity, zeta chain phosphorylation, and T cell activation.
AIMed.d63.s547.orig_sentence: These findings strongly suggest that CD26 may be closely associated with the CD45 protein tyrosine phosphatase on T cell surface and further support the notion that the interaction of CD26 with CD45 results in enhanced tyrosine kinase activity, zeta chain phosphorylation, and T cell activation.

AIMed.d64.s548.sentence: cDNA cloning and expression of a human FGF receptor which binds acidic and basic FGF.
AIMed.d64.s548.orig_sentence: cDNA cloning and expression of a human FGF receptor which binds acidic and basic FGF.

AIMed.d64.s549.sentence: We have isolated and characterized a cDNA clone, PROTEIN0, encoding a human fibroblast growth factor (FGF) receptor. PROTEIN1 contains an open reading frame which encodes an 820 amino acid polypeptide with three immunoglobulin-like domains in the extracellular part and an intracellular split tyrosine kinase domain.
AIMed.d64.s549.orig_sentence: We have isolated and characterized a cDNA clone, phFGFR, encoding a human fibroblast growth factor (FGF) receptor. phFGFR contains an open reading frame which encodes an 820 amino acid polypeptide with three immunoglobulin-like domains in the extracellular part and an intracellular split tyrosine kinase domain.

AIMed.d64.s550.sentence: Transient expression in COS-1 cells and immunoprecipitation using an antiserum raised against a C-terminal peptide, gave rise to two components, representing mature (130 kDa) and precursor (115 kDa) forms of the PROTEIN0 encoded polypeptide, which was denoted PROTEIN1.

AIMed.d65.s554.sentence: Cross-family dimerization of transcription factors PROTEIN0/PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2/PROTEIN3 alters DNA binding specificity.
AIMed.d65.s554.orig_sentence: Cross-family dimerization of transcription factors Fos/Jun and ATF/CREB alters DNA binding specificity.

AIMed.d65.s555.orig_sentence: The Fos/Jun and ATF/CREB families of transcription factors function in coupling extracellular signals to alterations in expression of specific target genes.

AIMed.d65.s556.sentence: Like many eukaryotic transcription factors, these proteins bind to DNA as dimers.

AIMed.d65.s557.sentence: Dimerization is mediated by a structure known as the "leucine-zipper" motif.
AIMed.d65.s557.orig_sentence: Dimerization is mediated by a structure known as the "leucine-zipper" motif.

AIMed.d65.s558.sentence: Although PROTEIN0/PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2/PROTEIN3 were previously thought to interact preferentially with different DNA regulatory elements (the AP-1/TRE and ATF/CRE sites, respectively), we find that members of these two families form selective cross-family heterodimers.
AIMed.d65.s558.orig_sentence: Although Fos/Jun and ATF/CREB were previously thought to interact preferentially with different DNA regulatory elements (the AP-1/TRE and ATF/CRE sites, respectively), we find that members of these two families form selective cross-family heterodimers.

AIMed.d65.s559.sentence: The resulting heterodimers display distinguishable DNA binding specificities from each other and from their parental homodimers.
AIMed.d65.s559.orig_sentence: The resulting heterodimers display distinguishable DNA binding specificities from each other and from their parental homodimers.

AIMed.d65.s560.sentence: These findings indicate that the PROTEIN0/PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2/PROTEIN3 families of transcription factors are not as distinct as was previously thought.
AIMed.d65.s560.orig_sentence: These findings indicate that the Fos/Jun and ATF/CREB families of transcription factors are not as distinct as was previously thought.

AIMed.d65.s561.sentence: We suggest that they can be grouped into a superfamily of transcription factors.
AIMed.d65.s561.orig_sentence: We suggest that they can be grouped into a superfamily of transcription factors.

AIMed.d67.s570.sentence: Activation of the PROTEIN0 protein kinase at different stages of the cell cycle is regulated by post-translational modifications and interactions with cyclins.

AIMed.d67.s573.sentence: The replacement of Thr161, a residue conserved and phosphorylated in other protein kinases, with valine inhibits PROTEIN0 association with A and B cyclins.
AIMed.d67.s573.orig_sentence: The replacement of Thr161, a residue conserved and phosphorylated in other protein kinases, with valine inhibits cdc2 association with A and B cyclins.

AIMed.d67.s574.sentence: In addition, mutations in the amino-terminus of PROTEIN0 and within the conserved 'PSTAIR' region strongly inhibit binding.

AIMed.d67.s575.sentence: The Thr161Val mutation causes a lethal phenotype in the fission yeast Schizosaccharomyces pombe, while replacement of Thr161 with glutamic acid, potentially mimicking phosphorylation, causes uncoordination of mitosis and multiple cytokinesis.
AIMed.d67.s575.orig_sentence: The Thr161Val mutation causes a lethal phenotype in the fission yeast Schizosaccharomyces pombe, while replacement of Thr161 with glutamic acid, potentially mimicking phosphorylation, causes uncoordination of mitosis and multiple cytokinesis.

AIMed.d67.s576.sentence: These results suggest that a threonine phosphorylation/dephosphorylation cycle is involved in regulating PROTEIN0 function.

AIMed.d68.s577.orig_sentence: Specific activation of cdc25 tyrosine phosphatases by B-type cyclins: evidence for multiple roles of mitotic cyclins.

AIMed.d68.s578.sentence: Two previously unidentified human PROTEIN0 genes have been isolated, PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2.

PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2 display endogenous tyrosine phosphatase activity that is stimulated several-fold, in the absence of cdc2, by stoichiometric addition of either PROTEIN3 or B2 but not A or D1.

AIMed.d68.s582.sentence: These findings indicate that B-type cyclins are multifunctional proteins that not only act as M phase regulatory subunits of the PROTEIN0 protein kinase, but also activate the PROTEIN1 tyrosine phosphatase, of which PROTEIN2 is the physiological substrate.

AIMed.d68.s583.sentence: A region of amino acid similarity between cyclins and tyrosine PTPases has been detected.
AIMed.d68.s583.orig_sentence: A region of amino acid similarity between cyclins and tyrosine PTPases has been detected.

AIMed.d68.s584.sentence: This region is absent in PROTEIN0 phosphatases.

AIMed.d68.s585.sentence: The motif may represent an activating domain that has to be provided to PROTEIN0 by intermolecular interaction with PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d68.s585.orig_sentence: The motif may represent an activating domain that has to be provided to cdc25 by intermolecular interaction with cyclin B.

AIMed.d69.s586.sentence: Activation of PROTEIN0 decreases phosphorylation of PROTEIN1 at sites that negatively regulate its DNA-binding activity.
AIMed.d69.s586.orig_sentence: Activation of protein kinase C decreases phosphorylation of c-Jun at sites that negatively regulate its DNA-binding activity.

AIMed.d69.s587.sentence: In resting human epithelial and fibroblastic cells, PROTEIN0 is phosphorylated on serine and threonine at five sites, three of which are phosphorylated in vitro by PROTEIN1 (PROTEIN2).
AIMed.d69.s587.orig_sentence: In resting human epithelial and fibroblastic cells, c-Jun is phosphorylated on serine and threonine at five sites, three of which are phosphorylated in vitro by glycogen synthase kinase 3 (GSK-3).

AIMed.d69.s588.sentence: These three sites are nested within a single tryptic peptide located just upstream of the basic region of the PROTEIN0 DNA-binding domain (residues 227-252).

AIMed.d69.s589.sentence: Activation of PROTEIN0 results in rapid, site-specific dephosphorylation of PROTEIN1 at one or more of these three sites and is coincident with increased PROTEIN2-binding activity.

AIMed.d69.s590.sentence: Phosphorylation of recombinant human PROTEIN0 proteins in vitro by PROTEIN1 decreases their DNA-binding activity.

AIMed.d69.s591.sentence: Mutation of serine 243 to phenylalanine blocks phosphorylation of all three sites in vivo and increases the inherent trans-activation ability of PROTEIN0 at least 10-fold.
AIMed.d69.s591.orig_sentence: Mutation of serine 243 to phenylalanine blocks phosphorylation of all three sites in vivo and increases the inherent trans-activation ability of c-Jun at least 10-fold.

AIMed.d69.s592.sentence: We propose that PROTEIN0 is present in resting cells in a latent, phosphorylated form that can be activated by site-specific dephosphorylation in response to PROTEIN1 activation.
AIMed.d69.s592.orig_sentence: We propose that c-Jun is present in resting cells in a latent, phosphorylated form that can be activated by site-specific dephosphorylation in response to protein kinase C activation.

AIMed.d70.s599.orig_sentence: Specifically, substitution of proline for Ala-498 significantly diminished RII alpha binding, and similar mutation of Ile-502 or Ile-507 abolished interaction.

AIMed.d70.s600.orig_sentence: Mutation of Ala-522 to proline, which is located outside the predicted amphipathic helix region, had no effect on RII alpha binding.

AIMed.d70.s601.sentence: These data suggest that anchoring proteins interact with PROTEIN0 PROTEIN1 via an amphipathic helix binding motif.

AIMed.d71.s602.orig_sentence: Phosphorylation of c-jun mediated by MAP kinases.

AIMed.d71.s607.sentence: The PROTEIN0 enzymes PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2/44 are regulated by tyrosine as well as serine/threonine phosphorylation.

AIMed.d77.s652.sentence: PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1), a desmosomal component lacking a transmembrane domain, has been implicated in this interaction, although most studies have been conducted with cells that contain few or no desmosomes, and efforts to demonstrate direct interactions between desmoplakin and intermediate filaments have not been successful.
AIMed.d77.s652.orig_sentence: Desmoplakin (DPI), a desmosomal component lacking a transmembrane domain, has been implicated in this interaction, although most studies have been conducted with cells that contain few or no desmosomes, and efforts to demonstrate direct interactions between desmoplakin and intermediate filaments have not been successful.

AIMed.d77.s653.sentence: In this report, we explore the biochemical nature of the connections between keratin filaments and desmosomes in epidermal keratinocytes.
AIMed.d77.s653.orig_sentence: In this report, we explore the biochemical nature of the connections between keratin filaments and desmosomes in epidermal keratinocytes.

AIMed.d77.s654.sentence: We show that the carboxy terminal "tail" of PROTEIN0 associates directly with the amino terminal "head" of type II epidermal keratins, including PROTEIN1, PROTEIN2, PROTEIN3, and PROTEIN4.
AIMed.d77.s654.orig_sentence: We show that the carboxy terminal "tail" of DPI associates directly with the amino terminal "head" of type II epidermal keratins, including K1, K2, K5, and K6.

AIMed.d77.s655.sentence: We have engineered and purified recombinant PROTEIN0 head and PROTEIN1 tail, and we demonstrate direct interaction in vitro by solution-binding assays and by ligand blot assays.
AIMed.d77.s655.orig_sentence: We have engineered and purified recombinant K5 head and DPI tail, and we demonstrate direct interaction in vitro by solution-binding assays and by ligand blot assays.

AIMed.d77.s656.sentence: This marked association is not seen with simple epithelial type II keratins, PROTEIN0, or with type I keratins, providing a possible explanation for the greater stability of the epidermal keratin filament architecture over that of other cell types.
AIMed.d77.s656.orig_sentence: This marked association is not seen with simple epithelial type II keratins, vimentin, or with type I keratins, providing a possible explanation for the greater stability of the epidermal keratin filament architecture over that of other cell types.

AIMed.d77.s657.sentence: We have identified an 18-amino acid residue stretch in the PROTEIN0 head that is conserved only among type II epidermal keratins and that appears to play some role in PROTEIN1 tail binding.
AIMed.d77.s657.orig_sentence: We have identified an 18-amino acid residue stretch in the K5 head that is conserved only among type II epidermal keratins and that appears to play some role in DPI tail binding.

AIMed.d77.s658.sentence: This finding might have important implications for understanding a recent point mutation found within this binding site in a family with a blistering skin disorder.
AIMed.d77.s658.orig_sentence: This finding might have important implications for understanding a recent point mutation found within this binding site in a family with a blistering skin disorder.

AIMed.d79.s671.sentence: The PROTEIN0 protein binds to PROTEIN1, a zinc-finger protein that shares an epitope with the adenovirus PROTEIN2 protein.
AIMed.d79.s671.orig_sentence: The retinoblastoma protein binds to RIZ, a zinc-finger protein that shares an epitope with the adenovirus E1A protein.

AIMed.d79.s672.sentence: The PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1) is a target of viral oncoproteins.
AIMed.d79.s672.orig_sentence: The retinoblastoma protein (Rb) is a target of viral oncoproteins.

AIMed.d79.s673.sentence: To explore the hypothesis that viral proteins may be structural mimics of cellular proteins, we have searched cDNA libraries for PROTEIN0-binding proteins.
AIMed.d79.s673.orig_sentence: To explore the hypothesis that viral proteins may be structural mimics of cellular proteins, we have searched cDNA libraries for Rb-binding proteins.

AIMed.d79.s674.sentence: We report here the cloning of a cDNA for the protein PROTEIN0 from rat and human cells.
AIMed.d79.s674.orig_sentence: We report here the cloning of a cDNA for the protein RIZ from rat and human cells.

AIMed.d79.s675.sentence: PROTEIN0 is a 250-kDa nuclear protein containing eight zinc-finger motifs.
AIMed.d79.s675.orig_sentence: RIZ is a 250-kDa nuclear protein containing eight zinc-finger motifs.

AIMed.d79.s676.sentence: It contains an PROTEIN0-binding motif that shares an antigenic epitope with the C terminus of PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d79.s676.orig_sentence: It contains an Rb-binding motif that shares an antigenic epitope with the C terminus of E1A.

AIMed.d79.s677.sentence: A domain is conserved between PROTEIN0 and the PROTEIN1/PROTEIN2 differentiation factor.
AIMed.d79.s677.orig_sentence: A domain is conserved between RIZ and the PRDI-BF1/Blimp-1 differentiation factor.

AIMed.d79.s678.sentence: Other motifs of PROTEIN0 include putative GTPase and SH3 (src homology domain 3) domains.
AIMed.d79.s678.orig_sentence: Other motifs of RIZ include putative GTPase and SH3 (src homology domain 3) domains.

AIMed.d79.s679.sentence: PROTEIN0 is preferentially expressed in both adult and embryonic rat neuroendocrine tissues.
AIMed.d79.s679.orig_sentence: RIZ is preferentially expressed in both adult and embryonic rat neuroendocrine tissues.

AIMed.d79.s680.sentence: It is also expressed in human retinoblastoma cells and at low levels in all other human cell lines examined.
AIMed.d79.s680.orig_sentence: It is also expressed in human retinoblastoma cells and at low levels in all other human cell lines examined.

AIMed.d79.s681.sentence: While the function of PROTEIN0 is not yet clear, its structure and pattern of expression suggest a role for PROTEIN1 in transcriptional regulation during neuronal differentiation and pathogenesis of retinoblastoma.
AIMed.d79.s681.orig_sentence: While the function of RIZ is not yet clear, its structure and pattern of expression suggest a role for RIZ in transcriptional regulation during neuronal differentiation and pathogenesis of retinoblastoma.

AIMed.d80.s682.sentence: PROTEIN0, a novel death domain-containing protein, interacts with the death domain of PROTEIN1 and initiates apoptosis.
AIMed.d80.s682.orig_sentence: FADD, a novel death domain-containing protein, interacts with the death domain of Fas and initiates apoptosis.

AIMed.d80.s683.sentence: Using the cytoplasmic domain of PROTEIN0 in the yeast two-hybrid system, we have identified a novel interacting protein, PROTEIN1, which binds PROTEIN2 and PROTEIN3-PROTEIN4, a mutant of PROTEIN5 possessing enhanced killing activity, but not the functionally inactive mutants PROTEIN6-PROTEIN7 and PROTEIN8-PROTEIN9.
AIMed.d80.s683.orig_sentence: Using the cytoplasmic domain of Fas in the yeast two-hybrid system, we have identified a novel interacting protein, FADD, which binds Fas and Fas-FD5, a mutant of Fas possessing enhanced killing activity, but not the functionally inactive mutants Fas-LPR and Fas-FD8.

AIMed.d80.s684.sentence: PROTEIN0 contains a death domain homologous to the death domains of PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d80.s684.orig_sentence: FADD contains a death domain homologous to the death domains of Fas and TNFR-1.

AIMed.d80.s685.sentence: A point mutation in PROTEIN0, analogous to the lpr mutation of PROTEIN1, abolishes its ability to bind PROTEIN2, suggesting a death domain to death domain interaction.
AIMed.d80.s685.orig_sentence: A point mutation in FADD, analogous to the lpr mutation of Fas, abolishes its ability to bind Fas, suggesting a death domain to death domain interaction.

AIMed.d80.s686.sentence: Overexpression of PROTEIN0 in MCF7 and BJAB cells induces apoptosis, which, like PROTEIN1-induced apoptosis, is blocked by PROTEIN2, a specific inhibitor of the PROTEIN3 PROTEIN4.
AIMed.d80.s686.orig_sentence: Overexpression of FADD in MCF7 and BJAB cells induces apoptosis, which, like Fas-induced apoptosis, is blocked by CrmA, a specific inhibitor of the interleukin-1 beta-converting enzyme.

AIMed.d80.s687.sentence: These findings suggest that PROTEIN0 may play an important role in the proximal signal transduction of PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d80.s687.orig_sentence: These findings suggest that FADD may play an important role in the proximal signal transduction of Fas.

AIMed.d81.s688.sentence: PROTEIN0: a novel protein containing a death domain that interacts with PROTEIN1/PROTEIN2 (PROTEIN3) in yeast and causes cell death.
AIMed.d81.s688.orig_sentence: RIP: a novel protein containing a death domain that interacts with Fas/APO-1 (CD95) in yeast and causes cell death.

AIMed.d81.s689.sentence: Ligation of the extracellular domain of the cell surface receptor PROTEIN0/PROTEIN1 (PROTEIN2) elicits a characteristic programmed death response in susceptible cells.
AIMed.d81.s689.orig_sentence: Ligation of the extracellular domain of the cell surface receptor Fas/APO-1 (CD95) elicits a characteristic programmed death response in susceptible cells.

AIMed.d81.s690.sentence: Using a genetic selection based on protein-protein interaction in yeast, we have identified two gene products that associate with the intracellular domain of PROTEIN0: PROTEIN1 itself, and a novel 74 kDa protein we have named PROTEIN2, for PROTEIN3.
AIMed.d81.s690.orig_sentence: Using a genetic selection based on protein-protein interaction in yeast, we have identified two gene products that associate with the intracellular domain of Fas: Fas itself, and a novel 74 kDa protein we have named RIP, for receptor interacting protein.

AIMed.d81.s691.sentence: PROTEIN0 also interacts weakly with the PROTEIN1 tumor necrosis factor receptor (PROTEIN2) intracellular domain, but not with a mutant version of PROTEIN3 corresponding to the murine lprcg mutation.
AIMed.d81.s691.orig_sentence: RIP also interacts weakly with the p55 tumor necrosis factor receptor (TNFR1) intracellular domain, but not with a mutant version of Fas corresponding to the murine lprcg mutation.

AIMed.d81.s692.sentence: PROTEIN0 contains an N-terminal region with homology to protein kinases and a C-terminal region containing a cytoplasmic motif (death domain) present in the PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2 intracellular domains.
AIMed.d81.s692.orig_sentence: RIP contains an N-terminal region with homology to protein kinases and a C-terminal region containing a cytoplasmic motif (death domain) present in the Fas and TNFR1 intracellular domains.

AIMed.d81.s693.sentence: Transient overexpression of PROTEIN0 causes transfected cells to undergo the morphological changes characteristic of apoptosis.
AIMed.d81.s693.orig_sentence: Transient overexpression of RIP causes transfected cells to undergo the morphological changes characteristic of apoptosis.

AIMed.d81.s694.sentence: Taken together, these properties indicate that PROTEIN0 is a novel form of apoptosis-inducing protein.
AIMed.d81.s694.orig_sentence: Taken together, these properties indicate that RIP is a novel form of apoptosis-inducing protein.

AIMed.d82.s695.sentence: Identification of an 11-kDa PROTEIN0-rapamycin-binding domain within the 289-kDa PROTEIN1 and characterization of a critical serine residue.
AIMed.d82.s695.orig_sentence: Identification of an 11-kDa FKBP12-rapamycin-binding domain within the 289-kDa FKBP12-rapamycin-associated protein and characterization of a critical serine residue.

AIMed.d82.s696.sentence: Complexed with its intracellular receptor, PROTEIN0, the natural product rapamycin inhibits G1 progression of the cell cycle in a variety of mammalian cell lines and in the yeast Saccharomyces cerevisae.
AIMed.d82.s696.orig_sentence: Complexed with its intracellular receptor, FKBP12, the natural product rapamycin inhibits G1 progression of the cell cycle in a variety of mammalian cell lines and in the yeast Saccharomyces cerevisae.

AIMed.d82.s697.sentence: Previously, a mammalian protein that directly associates with PROTEIN0-rapamycin has been identified and its encoding gene has been cloned from both human (designated PROTEIN1) [Brown, E.J., Albers, M.W., Shin, T.B., Ichikawa, K., Keith, C.T., Lane, W.S. & Schreiber, S.L. (1994) Nature (London) 369, 756-758] and rat (designated PROTEIN2) [Sabatini, D.M., Erdjument-Bromage, H., Lui, M., Tempst, P. & Snyder, S.H. (1994) Cell 78, 35-43].
AIMed.d82.s697.orig_sentence: Previously, a mammalian protein that directly associates with FKBP12-rapamycin has been identified and its encoding gene has been cloned from both human (designated FRAP) [Brown, E.J., Albers, M.W., Shin, T.B., Ichikawa, K., Keith, C.T., Lane, W.S. & Schreiber, S.L. (1994) Nature (London) 369, 756-758] and rat (designated RAFT) [Sabatini, D.M., Erdjument-Bromage, H., Lui, M., Tempst, P. & Snyder, S.H. (1994) Cell 78, 35-43].

AIMed.d82.s698.sentence: The full-length PROTEIN0 is a 289-kDa protein containing a putative phosphatidylinositol kinase domain.
AIMed.d82.s698.orig_sentence: The full-length FRAP is a 289-kDa protein containing a putative phosphatidylinositol kinase domain.

AIMed.d82.s699.sentence: Using an in vitro transcription/translation assay method coupled with proteolysis studies, we have identified an 11-kDa PROTEIN0-rapamycin-binding domain within PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d82.s699.orig_sentence: Using an in vitro transcription/translation assay method coupled with proteolysis studies, we have identified an 11-kDa FKBP12-rapamycin-binding domain within FRAP.

AIMed.d82.s700.sentence: This minimal binding domain lies N-terminal to the kinase domain and spans residues 2025-2114.
AIMed.d82.s700.orig_sentence: This minimal binding domain lies N-terminal to the kinase domain and spans residues 2025-2114.

AIMed.d82.s701.sentence: In addition, we have carried out mutagenesis studies to investigate the role of Ser2035, a potential phosphorylation site for PROTEIN0 within this domain.
AIMed.d82.s701.orig_sentence: In addition, we have carried out mutagenesis studies to investigate the role of Ser2035, a potential phosphorylation site for protein kinase C within this domain.

AIMed.d82.s702.sentence: We now show that the PROTEIN0 Ser2035-->Ala mutant displays similar binding affinity when compared with the wild-type protein, whereas all other mutations at this site, including mimics of phosphoserine, abolish binding, presumably due to either unfavorable steric interactions or induced conformational changes.
AIMed.d82.s702.orig_sentence: We now show that the FRAP Ser2035-->Ala mutant displays similar binding affinity when compared with the wild-type protein, whereas all other mutations at this site, including mimics of phosphoserine, abolish binding, presumably due to either unfavorable steric interactions or induced conformational changes.

AIMed.d83.s703.sentence: Localization of functional receptor epitopes on the structure of ciliary neurotrophic factor indicates a conserved, function-related epitope topography among helical cytokines.
AIMed.d83.s703.orig_sentence: Localization of functional receptor epitopes on the structure of ciliary neurotrophic factor indicates a conserved, function-related epitope topography among helical cytokines.

AIMed.d83.s704.sentence: By rational mutagenesis, receptor-specific functional analysis, and visualization of complex formation in solution, we identified individual amino acid side chains involved specifically in the interaction of PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1) with PROTEIN2 and not with the beta-components, PROTEIN3 and PROTEIN4.
AIMed.d83.s704.orig_sentence: By rational mutagenesis, receptor-specific functional analysis, and visualization of complex formation in solution, we identified individual amino acid side chains involved specifically in the interaction of ciliary neurotrophic factor (CNTF) with CNTFR alpha and not with the beta-components, gp130 and LIFR.

AIMed.d83.s705.sentence: In the crystal structure, the side chains of these residues, which are located in helix A, the AB loop, helix B, and helix D, are surface accessible and are clustered in space, thus constituting an epitope for PROTEIN0.
AIMed.d83.s705.orig_sentence: In the crystal structure, the side chains of these residues, which are located in helix A, the AB loop, helix B, and helix D, are surface accessible and are clustered in space, thus constituting an epitope for CNTFR alpha.

AIMed.d83.s706.sentence: By the same analysis, a partial epitope for PROTEIN0 was also identified on the surface of helix A that faces away from the alpha-epitope.
AIMed.d83.s706.orig_sentence: By the same analysis, a partial epitope for gp130 was also identified on the surface of helix A that faces away from the alpha-epitope.

AIMed.d83.s707.sentence: Superposition of the PROTEIN0 and growth hormone structures showed that the location of these epitopes on PROTEIN1 is analogous to the location of the first and second receptor epitopes on the surface of growth hormone.
AIMed.d83.s707.orig_sentence: Superposition of the CNTF and growth hormone structures showed that the location of these epitopes on CNTF is analogous to the location of the first and second receptor epitopes on the surface of growth hormone.

AIMed.d83.s708.sentence: Further comparison with proposed binding sites for alpha- and beta-receptors on PROTEIN0 and leukemia inhibitory factor indicated that this epitope topology is conserved among helical cytokines.
AIMed.d83.s708.orig_sentence: Further comparison with proposed binding sites for alpha- and beta-receptors on interleukin-6 and leukemia inhibitory factor indicated that this epitope topology is conserved among helical cytokines.

AIMed.d83.s709.sentence: In each case, epitope I is utilized by the specificity-conferring component, whereas epitopes II and III are used by accessory components.
AIMed.d83.s709.orig_sentence: In each case, epitope I is utilized by the specificity-conferring component, whereas epitopes II and III are used by accessory components.

AIMed.d83.s710.sentence: Thus, in addition to a common fold, helical cytokines share a conserved order of receptor epitopes that is function related.
AIMed.d83.s710.orig_sentence: Thus, in addition to a common fold, helical cytokines share a conserved order of receptor epitopes that is function related.

AIMed.d85.s717.orig_sentence: Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome protein physically associates with Nck through Src homology 3 domains.

AIMed.d85.s718.sentence: In the second of a series of experiments designed to identify PROTEIN0-Src homology 3 (SH3)-binding molecules, we report the cloning of PROTEIN1 (PROTEIN2) from an HL60 cDNA expression library.

AIMed.d85.s720.orig_sentence: Studies in vivo and in vitro demonstrated a highly specific interaction between the SH3 domains of p47nck and Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome protein.

AIMed.d85.s722.sentence: In vitro translation studies identified the 66-kDa protein as the protein product of PROTEIN0, and subcellular fractionation experiments showed that PROTEIN1 is mainly present in the cytosol fraction, although significant amounts are also present in membrane and nuclear fractions.

AIMed.d85.s723.orig_sentence: The main p47nck region implicated in the association with p66WASP was found to be the carboxy-terminal SH3 domain.

AIMed.d87.s733.orig_sentence: Interaction of p85 subunit of PI 3-kinase with insulin and IGF-1 receptors analysed by using the two-hybrid system.

AIMed.d90.s767.orig_sentence: Using radiolabeled PU.1 protein as a probe, we screened a B cell cDNA expression library and isolated a number of clones encoding PU.1 interacting proteins.

AIMed.d90.s768.sentence: Three of these clones encode DNA binding proteins (PROTEIN0, PROTEIN1, and PROTEIN2), one clone encodes a chaperone protein, and another clone encodes a multifunctional phosphatase.
AIMed.d90.s768.orig_sentence: Three of these clones encode DNA binding proteins (NF-IL6 beta, HMG I/Y, and SSRP), one clone encodes a chaperone protein, and another clone encodes a multifunctional phosphatase.

AIMed.d90.s769.sentence: We have characterized the physical and functional interactions between PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1, a leucine zipper transcription factor implicated in inflammatory responses.
AIMed.d90.s769.orig_sentence: We have characterized the physical and functional interactions between PU.1 and NF-IL6 beta, a leucine zipper transcription factor implicated in inflammatory responses.

AIMed.d90.s770.sentence: We found that deletion of the carboxyl-terminal 28 amino acids of PROTEIN0 disrupted PROTEIN1-PROTEIN2 physical interaction.
AIMed.d90.s770.orig_sentence: We found that deletion of the carboxyl-terminal 28 amino acids of PU.1 disrupted PU.1-NF-IL6 beta physical interaction.

AIMed.d90.s771.sentence: This deletion disrupts the PROTEIN0 Ets domain.
AIMed.d90.s771.orig_sentence: This deletion disrupts the PU.1 Ets domain.

AIMed.d90.s772.sentence: Deletion of the PROTEIN0 leucine zipper domain also greatly diminished the interaction between these two proteins.
AIMed.d90.s772.orig_sentence: Deletion of the NF-IL6 beta leucine zipper domain also greatly diminished the interaction between these two proteins.

AIMed.d90.s773.sentence: In transient expression assays, we found that PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 can functionally cooperate to synergistically activate transcription.
AIMed.d90.s773.orig_sentence: In transient expression assays, we found that PU.1 and NF-IL6 beta can functionally cooperate to synergistically activate transcription.

AIMed.d90.s774.sentence: Electrophoretic mobility shift assays showed that PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 can simultaneously bind to adjacent DNA binding sites, but apparently do not influence the kinetics or affinity of each other's DNA binding.
AIMed.d90.s774.orig_sentence: Electrophoretic mobility shift assays showed that PU.1 and NF-IL6 beta can simultaneously bind to adjacent DNA binding sites, but apparently do not influence the kinetics or affinity of each other's DNA binding.

AIMed.d90.s775.sentence: These results suggest that transcriptional synergy is due to each protein independently influencing the basal transcription complex.
AIMed.d90.s775.orig_sentence: These results suggest that transcriptional synergy is due to each protein independently influencing the basal transcription complex.

AIMed.d91.s776.sentence: Molecular cloning and expression of the 32-kDa subunit of human PROTEIN0 reveals interactions with PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2 that mediate transcriptional activation.
AIMed.d91.s776.orig_sentence: Molecular cloning and expression of the 32-kDa subunit of human TFIID reveals interactions with VP16 and TFIIB that mediate transcriptional activation.

AIMed.d91.s777.sentence: Transcription factor PROTEIN0 consists of PROTEIN1 (PROTEIN2) and at least eight PROTEIN3-associated factors (TAFs).
AIMed.d91.s777.orig_sentence: Transcription factor TFIID consists of TATA binding protein (TBP) and at least eight TBP-associated factors (TAFs).

AIMed.d91.s778.sentence: As TAFs are required for activated but not basal transcription, we have proposed that PROTEIN0 s act as coactivators to mediate signals between activators and the basal transcription machinery.
AIMed.d91.s778.orig_sentence: As TAFs are required for activated but not basal transcription, we have proposed that TAFs act as coactivators to mediate signals between activators and the basal transcription machinery.

AIMed.d91.s779.sentence: Here we report the cloning, expression, and biochemical characterization of the 32-kDa subunit of human (h) PROTEIN0, termed PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d91.s779.orig_sentence: Here we report the cloning, expression, and biochemical characterization of the 32-kDa subunit of human (h) TFIID, termed hTAFII32.

AIMed.d91.s780.sentence: We find that PROTEIN0 is the human homologue of Drosophila PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d91.s780.orig_sentence: We find that hTAFII32 is the human homologue of Drosophila TAFII40.

AIMed.d91.s781.sentence: In vitro protein-protein interaction assays reveal that as observed with Drosophila PROTEIN0, PROTEIN1 interacts with the C-terminal 39-amino acid activation domain of the acidic transactivator PROTEIN2 (PROTEIN3) as well as with the general transcription factor PROTEIN4.
AIMed.d91.s781.orig_sentence: In vitro protein-protein interaction assays reveal that as observed with Drosophila TAFII40, hTAFII32 interacts with the C-terminal 39-amino acid activation domain of the acidic transactivator viral protein 16 (VP16) as well as with the general transcription factor TFIIB.

AIMed.d91.s782.sentence: Moreover, a partial recombinant PROTEIN0 complex containing PROTEIN1 was capable of mediating in vitro transcriptional activation by the PROTEIN2 activation domain.
AIMed.d91.s782.orig_sentence: Moreover, a partial recombinant TFIID complex containing hTAFII32 was capable of mediating in vitro transcriptional activation by the VP16 activation domain.

AIMed.d91.s783.sentence: These findings indicate that specific activator-coactivator interactions have been conserved between human and Drosophila and provide additional support for the function of these interactions in mediating transcriptional activation.
AIMed.d91.s783.orig_sentence: These findings indicate that specific activator-coactivator interactions have been conserved between human and Drosophila and provide additional support for the function of these interactions in mediating transcriptional activation.

AIMed.d92.s785.sentence: PROTEIN0 binds independently to two transmembrane receptors, the PROTEIN1 PROTEIN2 and the PROTEIN3 PROTEIN4 PROTEIN5, which are both co-expressed in the majority of neuronal cells that respond to PROTEIN6.

AIMed.d92.s786.sentence: Previous findings have suggested that appropriate co-expression of the two receptors gives rise to high affinity PROTEIN0 binding sites and increased neurotrophin responsiveness; however, evidence demonstrating a direct interaction between the two receptors in cell lines has been lacking.
AIMed.d92.s786.orig_sentence: Previous findings have suggested that appropriate co-expression of the two receptors gives rise to high affinity NGF binding sites and increased neurotrophin responsiveness; however, evidence demonstrating a direct interaction between the two receptors in cell lines has been lacking.

AIMed.d92.s788.sentence: Although multimeric complexes of PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 were not detected by affinity crosslinking, immunoprecipitation of cross-linked PROTEIN2 PROTEIN3 complexes with PROTEIN4-specific antibodies resulted in selective immunoprecipitation of crosslinked PROTEIN5.
AIMed.d92.s788.orig_sentence: Although multimeric complexes of trkA and p75 were not detected by affinity crosslinking, immunoprecipitation of cross-linked NGF-receptor complexes with trk-specific antibodies resulted in selective immunoprecipitation of crosslinked p75.

AIMed.d92.s789.sentence: Our results indicate that the PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 receptors can potentially interact, and that such an association may be responsible for the generation of high affinity PROTEIN2 binding sites.
AIMed.d92.s789.orig_sentence: Our results indicate that the trkA and p75 receptors can potentially interact, and that such an association may be responsible for the generation of high affinity NGF binding sites.

AIMed.d94.s795.sentence: Cloning and functional expression of a human eosinophil CC chemokine receptor.
AIMed.d94.s795.orig_sentence: Cloning and functional expression of a human eosinophil CC chemokine receptor.

AIMed.d94.s797.orig_sentence: We have isolated a human cDNA encoding the first eosinophil-selective chemokine receptor, designated CC chemokine receptor 3 (CC CKR3).

AIMed.d94.s799.sentence: When [Ca2+]i changes were monitored in stably transfected human embryonic kidney 293 cells, PROTEIN0 PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2 were both potent agonists for PROTEIN3 and PROTEIN4.
AIMed.d94.s799.orig_sentence: When [Ca2+]i changes were monitored in stably transfected human embryonic kidney 293 cells, (MIP)-1 alpha MIP and RANTES were both potent agonists for CC CKR3 and CC CKR1.

AIMed.d94.s801.sentence: PROTEIN0 may be one of the host factors responsible for selective recruitment of eosinophils to sites of inflammation.

AIMed.d96.s806.orig_sentence: Receptor protein tyrosine phosphatase PTPmu associates with cadherins and catenins in vivo.

AIMed.d96.s807.orig_sentence: The extracellular segment of the receptor-type type protein tyrosine phosphatase PTPmu, possesses an MAM domain, an immunoglobulin domain, and four fibronectin type-III repeats.

AIMed.d96.s809.sentence: The intracellular segment of PROTEIN0 has two PTP domains and a juxtamembrane segment that is homologous to the conserved intracellular domain of the cadherins.
AIMed.d96.s809.orig_sentence: The intracellular segment of PTPmu has two PTP domains and a juxtamembrane segment that is homologous to the conserved intracellular domain of the cadherins.

AIMed.d96.s810.sentence: In cadherins, this segment interacts with proteins termed catenins to mediate association with the actin cytoskeleton.
AIMed.d96.s810.orig_sentence: In cadherins, this segment interacts with proteins termed catenins to mediate association with the actin cytoskeleton.

AIMed.d96.s811.sentence: In this article, we demonstrate that PROTEIN0 associates with a complex containing PROTEIN1- and PROTEIN2 in mink lung (MvLu) cells, and in rat heart, lung, and brain tissues.
AIMed.d96.s811.orig_sentence: In this article, we demonstrate that PTPmu associates with a complex containing cadherins, alpha- and beta-catenin in mink lung (MvLu) cells, and in rat heart, lung, and brain tissues.

AIMed.d96.s812.sentence: Greater than 80% of the cadherin in the cell is cleared from Triton X-100 lysates of MvLu cells after immunoprecipitation with antibodies to PROTEIN0; however, the complex is dissociated when lysates are prepared in more stringent, SDS-containing RIPA buffer.

AIMed.d96.s815.sentence: After pervanadate treatment of MvLu cells, which inhibits cellular tyrosine phosphatase activity including PROTEIN0, the cadherins associated with PROTEIN1 are now found in a tyrosine-phosphorylated form, indicating that the cadherins may be an endogenous substrate for PROTEIN2.

AIMed.d97.s817.sentence: Cloning and characterization of a human type II receptor for bone morphogenetic proteins.
AIMed.d97.s817.orig_sentence: Cloning and characterization of a human type II receptor for bone morphogenetic proteins.

AIMed.d97.s818.orig_sentence: Bone morphogenetic proteins (BMPs) are members of the transforming growth factor beta superfamily.

AIMed.d97.s819.sentence: Several members of this family have been shown to transduce their signals through binding to type I and type II serine-(threonine) kinase receptors.
AIMed.d97.s819.orig_sentence: Several members of this family have been shown to transduce their signals through binding to type I and type II serine-(threonine) kinase receptors.

AIMed.d97.s820.sentence: Here we report the cDNA cloning and characterization of a human type II receptor for BMPs (PROTEIN0), which is distantly related to PROTEIN1, a PROTEIN2 from Caenorhabditis elegans.
AIMed.d97.s820.orig_sentence: Here we report the cDNA cloning and characterization of a human type II receptor for BMPs (BMPR-II), which is distantly related to DAF-4, a BMP type II receptor from Caenorhabditis elegans.

AIMed.d97.s821.sentence: In transfected COS-1 cells, PROTEIN0/PROTEIN1, and less efficiently PROTEIN2, bound to PROTEIN3.

AIMed.d98.s826.orig_sentence: The cdc25 phosphatases play key roles in cell cycle progression by activating cyclin-dependent kinases.

AIMed.d98.s827.orig_sentence: Two members of the 14-3-3 protein family have been isolated in a yeast two-hybrid screen designed to identify proteins that interact with the human cdc25A and cdc25B phosphatases.

AIMed.d98.s828.sentence: Genes encoding the human homolog of the 14-3-3 epsilon protein and the previously described 14-3-3 beta protein have been isolated in this screening.
AIMed.d98.s828.orig_sentence: Genes encoding the human homolog of the 14-3-3 epsilon protein and the previously described 14-3-3 beta protein have been isolated in this screening.

AIMed.d98.s829.sentence: 14-3-3 proteins constitute a family of well-conserved eukaryotic proteins that were originally isolated in mammalian brain preparations and that possess diverse biochemical activities related to signal transduction.
AIMed.d98.s829.orig_sentence: 14-3-3 proteins constitute a family of well-conserved eukaryotic proteins that were originally isolated in mammalian brain preparations and that possess diverse biochemical activities related to signal transduction.

AIMed.d98.s830.orig_sentence: We present evidence that indicates that cdc25 and 14-3-3 proteins physically interact both in vitro and in vivo.

AIMed.d98.s831.sentence: 14-3-3 protein does not, however, affect the phosphatase activity of cdc25A.
AIMed.d98.s831.orig_sentence: 14-3-3 protein does not, however, affect the phosphatase activity of cdc25A.

AIMed.d98.s834.orig_sentence: Instead, 14-3-3 may facilitate the association of cdc25 with Raf-1 in vivo, participating in the linkage between mitogenic signaling and the cell cycle machinery.

AIMed.d99.s835.orig_sentence: The Cockayne syndrome group A gene encodes a WD repeat protein that interacts with CSB protein and a subunit of RNA polymerase II TFIIH.

AIMed.d100.s843.sentence: Cloning and expression of human PROTEIN0: a TBP-associated factor implicated in cell-cycle regulation.
AIMed.d100.s843.orig_sentence: Cloning and expression of human TAFII250: a TBP-associated factor implicated in cell-cycle regulation.
