AIMed.d101.s853.orig_sentence: Fos and Jun oncoproteins form a complex that regulates transcription from promoters containing AP-1 binding sites.

AIMed.d101.s854.sentence: These two proteins, like other transcriptional activators, are likely to stimulate transcription through direct and/or indirect interactions with members of the basal transcriptional machinery.
AIMed.d101.s854.orig_sentence: These two proteins, like other transcriptional activators, are likely to stimulate transcription through direct and/or indirect interactions with members of the basal transcriptional machinery.

AIMed.d101.s855.sentence: The ability of PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 proteins to interact directly with the PROTEIN2 (PROTEIN3), the general transcription factor required for initiating the assembly of transcription complexes, was investigated.
AIMed.d101.s855.orig_sentence: The ability of c-Fos and c-Jun proteins to interact directly with the TATA box-binding protein (TBP), the general transcription factor required for initiating the assembly of transcription complexes, was investigated.

AIMed.d101.s856.sentence: Using co-immunoprecipitation and protein-protein association assays, we show that both PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 bind specifically and stably to PROTEIN2.Mutational analysis demonstrates that both the basic region and leucine zipper domains of PROTEIN3 and PROTEIN4 are necessary and sufficient for stable association with PROTEIN5.
AIMed.d101.s856.orig_sentence: Using co-immunoprecipitation and protein-protein association assays, we show that both c-Fos and c-Jun bind specifically and stably to TBP.Mutational analysis demonstrates that both the basic region and leucine zipper domains of c-Fos and c-Jun are necessary and sufficient for stable association with TBP.

AIMed.d101.s857.sentence: A 51-residue region from the conserved C-terminal region of PROTEIN0, previously shown to be the binding site for the viral activator protein PROTEIN1, interacts with PROTEIN2 and PROTEIN3 proteins.
AIMed.d101.s857.orig_sentence: A 51-residue region from the conserved C-terminal region of TBP, previously shown to be the binding site for the viral activator protein E1A, interacts with c-Fos and c-Jun proteins.

AIMed.d101.s858.sentence: We propose that PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 proteins function as transcriptional activators, in part by recruiting PROTEIN2 to form complexes to initiate RNA synthesis.
AIMed.d101.s858.orig_sentence: We propose that c-Fos and c-Jun proteins function as transcriptional activators, in part by recruiting TBP to form complexes to initiate RNA synthesis.

AIMed.d102.s859.sentence: The PROTEIN0-susceptibility gene product binds directly to the human PROTEIN1 PROTEIN2 PROTEIN3.
AIMed.d102.s859.orig_sentence: The retinoblastoma-susceptibility gene product binds directly to the human TATA-binding protein-associated factor TAFII250.

AIMed.d102.s860.sentence: PROTEIN0, the protein product of the PROTEIN1 tumor-suppressor gene, regulates the activity of specific transcription factors.
AIMed.d102.s860.orig_sentence: RB, the protein product of the retinoblastoma tumor-suppressor gene, regulates the activity of specific transcription factors.

AIMed.d102.s861.sentence: This regulation appears to be mediated either directly through interactions with specific transcription factors or through an alternative mechanism.
AIMed.d102.s861.orig_sentence: This regulation appears to be mediated either directly through interactions with specific transcription factors or through an alternative mechanism.

AIMed.d102.s862.sentence: Here we report that stimulation of PROTEIN0-mediated transcription by PROTEIN1 is partially abrogated at the nonpermissive temperature in ts13 cells.
AIMed.d102.s862.orig_sentence: Here we report that stimulation of Sp1-mediated transcription by RB is partially abrogated at the nonpermissive temperature in ts13 cells.

AIMed.d102.s863.sentence: These cells contain a temperature-sensitive mutation in the PROTEIN0 PROTEIN1 PROTEIN2, first identified as the cell cycle regulatory protein PROTEIN3.
AIMed.d102.s863.orig_sentence: These cells contain a temperature-sensitive mutation in the TATA-binding protein-associated factor TAFII250, first identified as the cell cycle regulatory protein CCG1.

AIMed.d102.s864.sentence: The stimulation of PROTEIN0-mediated transcription by PROTEIN1 in ts13 cells at the nonpermissive temperature could be restored by the introduction of wild-type human PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d102.s864.orig_sentence: The stimulation of Sp1-mediated transcription by RB in ts13 cells at the nonpermissive temperature could be restored by the introduction of wild-type human TAFII250.

AIMed.d102.s865.sentence: Furthermore, we demonstrate that PROTEIN0 binds directly to PROTEIN1 in vitro and in vivo.
AIMed.d102.s865.orig_sentence: Furthermore, we demonstrate that RB binds directly to hTAFII250 in vitro and in vivo.

AIMed.d102.s866.sentence: These results suggest that PROTEIN0 can confer transcriptional regulation and possibly cell cycle control and tumor suppression through an interaction with PROTEIN1, in particular with PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d102.s866.orig_sentence: These results suggest that RB can confer transcriptional regulation and possibly cell cycle control and tumor suppression through an interaction with TFIID, in particular with TAFII250.

AIMed.d103.s867.sentence: Cloning and characterization of PROTEIN0, PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2: three subunits of the human transcription factor PROTEIN3.
AIMed.d103.s867.orig_sentence: Cloning and characterization of hTAFII18, hTAFII20 and hTAFII28: three subunits of the human transcription factor TFIID.

AIMed.d103.s868.sentence: We have cloned cDNAs encoding three novel TAFIIs [PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1)-associated factors] from the human (h) HeLa cell PROTEIN2 complexes PROTEIN3, PROTEIN4 and PROTEIN5. PROTEIN6 is a core PROTEIN7 present in both of the previously described PROTEIN8 species which either lack or contain PROTEIN9 (PROTEIN10 PROTEIN11 and PROTEIN12 PROTEIN13 respectively), and is the homologue of Drosophila (d)PROTEIN14. PROTEIN15 is a novel PROTEIN16 which shows homology to the N-terminal region of the yeast PROTEIN17, but has no known Drosophila counterpart.
AIMed.d103.s868.orig_sentence: We have cloned cDNAs encoding three novel TAFIIs [TATA-binding protein (TBP)-associated factors] from the human (h) HeLa cell TFIID complexes hTAFII28, hTAFII20 and hTAFII18. hTAFII28 is a core hTAFII present in both of the previously described hTFIID species which either lack or contain hTAFII30 (hTFIID alpha and hTFIID beta respectively), and is the homologue of Drosophila (d)TAFII30 beta. hTAFII18 is a novel hTAFII which shows homology to the N-terminal region of the yeast TAFIISPT3, but has no known Drosophila counterpart.

AIMed.d103.s869.sentence: In contrast to PROTEIN0, PROTEIN1 is a PROTEIN2 PROTEIN3-specific PROTEIN4. PROTEIN5 is the homologue of PROTEIN6, an alternatively spliced form of d PROTEIN7 (PROTEIN8).
AIMed.d103.s869.orig_sentence: In contrast to hTAFII28, hTAFII18 is a TFIID beta-specific hTAFII. hTAFII20 is the homologue of p22, an alternatively spliced form of dTAFII30 alpha (p32).

AIMed.d103.s870.sentence: Using a combination of protein affinity chromatography and cotransfection and immunoprecipitation assays, we have identified a series of in vitro and intracellular interactions among the novel hTAFIIs and between the novel hTAFIIs and PROTEIN0 or TBP.
AIMed.d103.s870.orig_sentence: Using a combination of protein affinity chromatography and cotransfection and immunoprecipitation assays, we have identified a series of in vitro and intracellular interactions among the novel hTAFIIs and between the novel hTAFIIs and hTAFII30 or TBP.

AIMed.d103.s871.sentence: We show that PROTEIN0 interacts with PROTEIN1 both in vitro and intracellularly; in contrast to its Drosophila homologue, PROTEIN2 also interacts directly with PROTEIN3.
AIMed.d103.s871.orig_sentence: We show that hTAFII28 interacts with hTAFII18 both in vitro and intracellularly; in contrast to its Drosophila homologue, hTAFII28 also interacts directly with TBP.

AIMed.d103.s872.sentence: Deletion analysis indicates that PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 bind to distinct domains of PROTEIN2. PROTEIN3 also interacts with PROTEIN4, but it interacts more strongly with PROTEIN5 and PROTEIN6.
AIMed.d103.s872.orig_sentence: Deletion analysis indicates that TBP and hTAFII18 bind to distinct domains of hTAFII28. hTAFII18 also interacts with TBP, but it interacts more strongly with hTAFII28 and hTAFII30.

AIMed.d103.s873.sentence: The binding of PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 requires distinct domains of PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d103.s873.orig_sentence: The binding of hTAFII28 and hTAFII30 requires distinct domains of hTAFII18.

AIMed.d103.s874.sentence: As observed with the homologous Drosophila proteins, PROTEIN0 interacts directly with PROTEIN1; however, additional interactions between PROTEIN2 and PROTEIN3 or PROTEIN4 were detected.
AIMed.d103.s874.orig_sentence: As observed with the homologous Drosophila proteins, hTAFII20 interacts directly with TBP; however, additional interactions between hTAFII20 and hTAFII28 or hTAFII30 were detected.

AIMed.d103.s875.sentence: These results reveal differences not only in subunit composition, but also in the organization of PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 complexes.
AIMed.d103.s875.orig_sentence: These results reveal differences not only in subunit composition, but also in the organization of dTFIID and hTFIID complexes.

AIMed.d104.s876.sentence: In vivo association of PROTEIN0 and DP family proteins.
AIMed.d104.s876.orig_sentence: In vivo association of E2F and DP family proteins.

AIMed.d104.s877.sentence: The mammalian transcription factor PROTEIN0 plays an important role in regulating the expression of genes that are required for passage through the cell cycle.
AIMed.d104.s877.orig_sentence: The mammalian transcription factor E2F plays an important role in regulating the expression of genes that are required for passage through the cell cycle.

AIMed.d104.s878.sentence: This transcriptional activity is inhibited by association with the PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1) or its relatives PROTEIN2 and PROTEIN3.
AIMed.d104.s878.orig_sentence: This transcriptional activity is inhibited by association with the retinoblastoma tumor suppressor protein (pRB) or its relatives p107 and p103.

AIMed.d104.s879.sentence: The first cDNA from the PROTEIN0 family to be cloned was designated PROTEIN1, and multiple PROTEIN2 family members have now been identified.
AIMed.d104.s879.orig_sentence: The first cDNA from the E2F family to be cloned was designated E2F-1, and multiple E2F family members have now been identified.

AIMed.d104.s880.sentence: They bind to DNA as heterodimers, interacting with proteins known as DP.
AIMed.d104.s880.orig_sentence: They bind to DNA as heterodimers, interacting with proteins known as DP.

AIMed.d104.s881.sentence: Here we demonstrate that DP is also a family of polypeptides with at least two members (PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1).
AIMed.d104.s881.orig_sentence: Here we demonstrate that DP is also a family of polypeptides with at least two members (hDP-1 and hDP-2).

AIMed.d104.s882.sentence: Both PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 bind to all PROTEIN2 family members in vivo, and each complex is capable of activating transcription.
AIMed.d104.s882.orig_sentence: Both hDP-1 and hDP-2 bind to all E2F family members in vivo, and each complex is capable of activating transcription.

AIMed.d104.s883.sentence: However, the various PROTEIN0/DP complexes display strong differences in the ability to bind to either PROTEIN1 or PROTEIN2 in vivo, and the specificity of PROTEIN3 or PROTEIN4 binding is mediated by the PROTEIN5 subunit.
AIMed.d104.s883.orig_sentence: However, the various E2F/DP complexes display strong differences in the ability to bind to either pRB or p107 in vivo, and the specificity of pRB or p107 binding is mediated by the E2F subunit.

AIMed.d105.s884.sentence: Two distinct and independent sites on PROTEIN0 trigger PROTEIN1 dimer formation and signalling.
AIMed.d105.s884.orig_sentence: Two distinct and independent sites on IL-6 trigger gp 130 dimer formation and signalling.

AIMed.d105.s885.sentence: The helical cytokine PROTEIN0 and its specific binding subunit PROTEIN1 form a 1:1 complex which, by promoting homodimerization of the signalling subunit PROTEIN2 on the surface of target cells, triggers intracellular responses.
AIMed.d105.s885.orig_sentence: The helical cytokine interleukin (IL) 6 and its specific binding subunit IL-6R alpha form a 1:1 complex which, by promoting homodimerization of the signalling subunit gp130 on the surface of target cells, triggers intracellular responses.

AIMed.d105.s886.sentence: We expressed differently tagged forms of PROTEIN0 and used them in solution-phase binding assays to show that the soluble extracellular domains of PROTEIN1 undergo dimerization in the absence of membranes.
AIMed.d105.s886.orig_sentence: We expressed differently tagged forms of gp130 and used them in solution-phase binding assays to show that the soluble extracellular domains of gp130 undergo dimerization in the absence of membranes.

AIMed.d105.s887.sentence: In vitro receptor assembly reactions were also performed in the presence of two sets of PROTEIN0 variants carrying amino acid substitutions in two distinct areas of the cytokine surface (site 2, comprising exposed residues in the A and C helices, and site 3, in the terminal part of the CD loop).
AIMed.d105.s887.orig_sentence: In vitro receptor assembly reactions were also performed in the presence of two sets of IL-6 variants carrying amino acid substitutions in two distinct areas of the cytokine surface (site 2, comprising exposed residues in the A and C helices, and site 3, in the terminal part of the CD loop).

AIMed.d105.s888.sentence: The binding affinity to PROTEIN0 of these variants is normal but their biological activity is poor or absent.
AIMed.d105.s888.orig_sentence: The binding affinity to IL-6R alpha of these variants is normal but their biological activity is poor or absent.

AIMed.d105.s889.sentence: We demonstrate here that both the site 2 and site 3 PROTEIN0 variants complexed with PROTEIN1 bind a single PROTEIN2 molecule but are unable to dimerize it, whereas the combined site 2/3 variants lose the ability to interact with PROTEIN3.
AIMed.d105.s889.orig_sentence: We demonstrate here that both the site 2 and site 3 IL-6 variants complexed with IL-6R alpha bind a single gp130 molecule but are unable to dimerize it, whereas the combined site 2/3 variants lose the ability to interact with gp130.

AIMed.d105.s890.sentence: The binding properties of these variants in vitro, and the result of using a neutralizing monoclonal antibody directed against site 3, lead to the conclusion that PROTEIN0 dimer is formed through direct binding at two independent and differently oriented sites on PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d105.s890.orig_sentence: The binding properties of these variants in vitro, and the result of using a neutralizing monoclonal antibody directed against site 3, lead to the conclusion that gp130 dimer is formed through direct binding at two independent and differently oriented sites on IL-6.

AIMed.d105.s891.sentence: Immunoprecipitation experiments further reveal that the fully assembled receptor complex is composed of two PROTEIN0, two PROTEIN1 and two PROTEIN2 molecules.
AIMed.d105.s891.orig_sentence: Immunoprecipitation experiments further reveal that the fully assembled receptor complex is composed of two IL-6, two IL-6R alpha and two gp130 molecules.

AIMed.d105.s892.sentence: We propose here a model representing the PROTEIN0 receptor complex as hexameric, which might be common to other helical cytokines.
AIMed.d105.s892.orig_sentence: We propose here a model representing the IL-6 receptor complex as hexameric, which might be common to other helical cytokines.

AIMed.d108.s909.sentence: PROTEIN0 transcriptional activation mediated by coactivators PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d108.s909.orig_sentence: p53 transcriptional activation mediated by coactivators TAFII40 and TAFII60.

AIMed.d108.s910.sentence: The tumor suppressor protein PROTEIN0 is a transcriptional regulator that enhances the expression of proteins that control cellular proliferation.
AIMed.d108.s910.orig_sentence: The tumor suppressor protein p53 is a transcriptional regulator that enhances the expression of proteins that control cellular proliferation.

AIMed.d108.s911.sentence: The multisubunit PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1) is thought to be a primary target for site-specific activators of transcription.
AIMed.d108.s911.orig_sentence: The multisubunit transcription factor IID (TFIID) is thought to be a primary target for site-specific activators of transcription.

AIMed.d108.s912.sentence: Here, a direct interaction between the activation domain of PROTEIN0 and two subunits of the PROTEIN1 complex, PROTEIN2 and PROTEIN3, is reported.
AIMed.d108.s912.orig_sentence: Here, a direct interaction between the activation domain of p53 and two subunits of the TFIID complex, TAFII40 and TAFII60, is reported.

AIMed.d108.s913.sentence: A double point mutation in the activation domain of PROTEIN0 impaired the ability of this domain to activate transcription and, simultaneously, its ability to interact with both PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d108.s913.orig_sentence: A double point mutation in the activation domain of p53 impaired the ability of this domain to activate transcription and, simultaneously, its ability to interact with both TAFII40 and TAFII60.

AIMed.d108.s914.sentence: Furthermore, a partial PROTEIN0 complex containing Drosophila PROTEIN1 (PROTEIN2), human PROTEIN3, PROTEIN4, and PROTEIN5 supported activation by a Gal4-p53 fusion protein in vitro, whereas PROTEIN6 or a subcomplex lacking PROTEIN7 and PROTEIN8 did not.
AIMed.d108.s914.orig_sentence: Furthermore, a partial TFIID complex containing Drosophila TATA binding protein (dTBP), human TAFII250, dTAFII60, and dTAFII40 supported activation by a Gal4-p53 fusion protein in vitro, whereas TBP or a subcomplex lacking TAFII40 and TAFII60 did not.

AIMed.d108.s915.sentence: Together, these results suggest that PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 are important targets for transmitting activation signals between PROTEIN2 and the initiation complex.
AIMed.d108.s915.orig_sentence: Together, these results suggest that TAFII40 and TAFII60 are important targets for transmitting activation signals between p53 and the initiation complex.

AIMed.d109.s916.sentence: Crystal structure of the heterodimeric bZIP transcription factor PROTEIN0-PROTEIN1 bound to DNA.
AIMed.d109.s916.orig_sentence: Crystal structure of the heterodimeric bZIP transcription factor c-Fos-c-Jun bound to DNA.

AIMed.d109.s917.sentence: The PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 families of eukaryotic transcription factors heterodimerize to form complexes capable of binding 5'-TGAGTCA-3' DNA elements.
AIMed.d109.s917.orig_sentence: The Fos and Jun families of eukaryotic transcription factors heterodimerize to form complexes capable of binding 5'-TGAGTCA-3' DNA elements.

AIMed.d109.s918.sentence: We have determined the X-ray crystal structure of a heterodimer of the bZIP regions of PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 bound to DNA.
AIMed.d109.s918.orig_sentence: We have determined the X-ray crystal structure of a heterodimer of the bZIP regions of c-Fos and c-Jun bound to DNA.

AIMed.d109.s920.sentence: The carboxy-terminal regions form an asymmetric coiled-coil, and the amino-terminal regions make base-specific contacts with DNA in the major groove.
AIMed.d109.s920.orig_sentence: The carboxy-terminal regions form an asymmetric coiled-coil, and the amino-terminal regions make base-specific contacts with DNA in the major groove.

AIMed.d109.s921.sentence: Comparison of the two crystallographically distinct protein-DNA complexes show that the coiled-coil is flexibly joined to the basic regions and that the PROTEIN0-PROTEIN1 heterodimer does not recognize the asymmetric 5'-TGAGTCA-3' recognition element in a unique orientation.
AIMed.d109.s921.orig_sentence: Comparison of the two crystallographically distinct protein-DNA complexes show that the coiled-coil is flexibly joined to the basic regions and that the Fos-Jun heterodimer does not recognize the asymmetric 5'-TGAGTCA-3' recognition element in a unique orientation.

AIMed.d109.s922.sentence: There is an extensive network of electrostatic interactions between subunits within the coiled-coil, consistent with proposals that these interactions determine preferential formation of the heterodimer over either of the homodimers.
AIMed.d109.s922.orig_sentence: There is an extensive network of electrostatic interactions between subunits within the coiled-coil, consistent with proposals that these interactions determine preferential formation of the heterodimer over either of the homodimers.

AIMed.d110.s923.sentence: Cloning of an intrinsic human PROTEIN0 subunit that interacts with multiple transcriptional activators.
AIMed.d110.s923.orig_sentence: Cloning of an intrinsic human TFIID subunit that interacts with multiple transcriptional activators.

AIMed.d110.s924.sentence: PROTEIN0 is a multisubunit protein complex comprised of the PROTEIN1 (PROTEIN2) and multiple TBP-associated factors (TAFs).
AIMed.d110.s924.orig_sentence: TFIID is a multisubunit protein complex comprised of the TATA-binding protein (TBP) and multiple TBP-associated factors (TAFs).

AIMed.d110.s925.sentence: The TAFs in PROTEIN0 are essential for activator-dependent transcription.
AIMed.d110.s925.orig_sentence: The TAFs in TFIID are essential for activator-dependent transcription.

AIMed.d110.s926.sentence: The cloning of a complementary DNA encoding a human PROTEIN0 TAF, PROTEIN1, that has no known homolog in Drosophila PROTEIN2 is now described.
AIMed.d110.s926.orig_sentence: The cloning of a complementary DNA encoding a human TFIID TAF, TAFII55, that has no known homolog in Drosophila TFIID is now described.

AIMed.d110.s927.sentence: PROTEIN0 is shown to interact with the largest subunit (PROTEIN1) of human PROTEIN2 through its central region and with multiple activators--including PROTEIN3, PROTEIN4, PROTEIN5, PROTEIN6, adenoviral PROTEIN7, and human immunodeficiency virus-type 1 PROTEIN8 proteins--through a distinct amino-terminal domain.
AIMed.d110.s927.orig_sentence: TAFII55 is shown to interact with the largest subunit (TAFII230) of human TFIID through its central region and with multiple activators--including Sp1, YY1, USF, CTF, adenoviral E1A, and human immunodeficiency virus-type 1 Tat proteins--through a distinct amino-terminal domain.

AIMed.d110.s928.sentence: The PROTEIN0-interacting region of PROTEIN1 was localized to its DNA-binding domain, which is distinct from the glutamine-rich activation domains previously shown to interact with Drosophila PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d110.s928.orig_sentence: The TAFII55-interacting region of Sp1 was localized to its DNA-binding domain, which is distinct from the glutamine-rich activation domains previously shown to interact with Drosophila TAFII110.

AIMed.d110.s929.sentence: Thus, this human PROTEIN0 TAF may be a co-activator that mediates a response to multiple activators through a distinct mechanism.
AIMed.d110.s929.orig_sentence: Thus, this human TFIID TAF may be a co-activator that mediates a response to multiple activators through a distinct mechanism.

AIMed.d112.s944.sentence: Human spleen tyrosine kinase PROTEIN0 associates with the Src-family kinase PROTEIN1/PROTEIN2 and a PROTEIN3.
AIMed.d112.s944.orig_sentence: Human spleen tyrosine kinase p72Syk associates with the Src-family kinase p53/56Lyn and a 120-kDa phosphoprotein.

AIMed.d112.s945.sentence: The 72-kDa spleen tyrosine kinase (PROTEIN0) and Src-family kinase PROTEIN1/PROTEIN2 (PROTEIN3) contribute to signaling via the B-cell antigen receptor complex.
AIMed.d112.s945.orig_sentence: The 72-kDa spleen tyrosine kinase (Syk) and Src-family kinase p53/56Lyn (Lyn) contribute to signaling via the B-cell antigen receptor complex.

AIMed.d112.s946.sentence: Here we show that PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 from human B lymphocytes can interact directly.
AIMed.d112.s946.orig_sentence: Here we show that Syk and Lyn from human B lymphocytes can interact directly.

AIMed.d112.s947.sentence: PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 coimmunoprecipitated from mature and activated B-cell lines, and gel-purified PROTEIN2 and PROTEIN3 reassociated in vitro, demonstrating their direct interaction.
AIMed.d112.s947.orig_sentence: Syk and Lyn coimmunoprecipitated from mature and activated B-cell lines, and gel-purified Syk and Lyn reassociated in vitro, demonstrating their direct interaction.

AIMed.d112.s948.sentence: This PROTEIN0-PROTEIN1 interaction may be dependent on the stage of B-cell differentiation, since PROTEIN2-PROTEIN3 associations were not detected in pre-B and myeloma cell lines and PROTEIN4 from an immature B-cell line did not reassociate with PROTEIN5 in vitro.
AIMed.d112.s948.orig_sentence: This Syk-Lyn interaction may be dependent on the stage of B-cell differentiation, since Syk-Lyn associations were not detected in pre-B and myeloma cell lines and Syk from an immature B-cell line did not reassociate with Lyn in vitro.

AIMed.d112.s949.sentence: Serine/threonine kinase activity was also associated with PROTEIN0.
AIMed.d112.s949.orig_sentence: Serine/threonine kinase activity was also associated with Syk.

AIMed.d112.s950.sentence: Crosslinking of cell surface IgM led to rapid activation of both tyrosine and serine/threonine protein kinase activities that resulted in phosphorylation in vitro of proteins coprecipitating with PROTEIN0--in particular, a serine/threonine phosphorylated protein 120 kDa in size (PROTEIN1).
AIMed.d112.s950.orig_sentence: Crosslinking of cell surface IgM led to rapid activation of both tyrosine and serine/threonine protein kinase activities that resulted in phosphorylation in vitro of proteins coprecipitating with Syk--in particular, a serine/threonine phosphorylated protein 120 kDa in size (pp120).

AIMed.d112.s951.sentence: Several phosphoproteins, including one of 72 kDa and one of 120 kDa, coprecipitated with PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1).
AIMed.d112.s951.orig_sentence: Several phosphoproteins, including one of 72 kDa and one of 120 kDa, coprecipitated with phospholipase C-gamma 1 (PLC gamma 1).

AIMed.d112.s952.sentence: Sequential immunoprecipitation identified the 72-kDa protein associated with PROTEIN0 as PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d112.s952.orig_sentence: Sequential immunoprecipitation identified the 72-kDa protein associated with PLC gamma 1 as Syk.

AIMed.d112.s953.sentence: The 120-kDa serine/threonine phosphorylated protein that coprecipitated with PROTEIN0 resembled the PROTEIN1-associated PROTEIN2 by several criteria.
AIMed.d112.s953.orig_sentence: The 120-kDa serine/threonine phosphorylated protein that coprecipitated with PLC gamma 1 resembled the Syk-associated pp120 by several criteria.

AIMed.d112.s954.sentence: Thus, PROTEIN0 may serve as a link between PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2, coupling the B-cell antigen receptor to the phosphatidylinositol pathway.
AIMed.d112.s954.orig_sentence: Thus, pp120 may serve as a link between Syk and PLC gamma 1, coupling the B-cell antigen receptor to the phosphatidylinositol pathway.

AIMed.d113.s955.sentence: Cloning and functional analysis of PROTEIN0: a novel PROTEIN1 PROTEIN2 with anti-cell death activity.
AIMed.d113.s955.orig_sentence: Cloning and functional analysis of BAG-1: a novel Bcl-2-binding protein with anti-cell death activity.

AIMed.d113.s956.sentence: Using a protein interaction cloning technique, we identified cDNAs that encode a novel PROTEIN0 PROTEIN1, termed PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d113.s956.orig_sentence: Using a protein interaction cloning technique, we identified cDNAs that encode a novel Bcl-2-binding protein, termed BAG-1.

AIMed.d113.s957.sentence: The PROTEIN0 protein shares no significant homology with PROTEIN1 or other PROTEIN2 family proteins, which can form homo- and heterodimers.
AIMed.d113.s957.orig_sentence: The BAG-1 protein shares no significant homology with Bcl-2 or other Bcl-2 family proteins, which can form homo- and heterodimers.

AIMed.d113.s958.sentence: In gene transfer experiments using a human lymphoid cell line, Jurkat, coexpression of PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 provided markedly increased protection from cell death induced by several stimuli, including staurosporine, anti-Fas antibody, and cytolytic T cells, relative to cells that contained gene transfer-mediated elevations in either PROTEIN2 or PROTEIN3 protein alone.
AIMed.d113.s958.orig_sentence: In gene transfer experiments using a human lymphoid cell line, Jurkat, coexpression of BAG-1 and Bcl-2 provided markedly increased protection from cell death induced by several stimuli, including staurosporine, anti-Fas antibody, and cytolytic T cells, relative to cells that contained gene transfer-mediated elevations in either BAG-1 or Bcl-2 protein alone.

AIMed.d113.s959.sentence: PROTEIN0-transfected 3T3 fibroblasts also exhibited prolonged cell survival in response to an apoptotic stimulus.
AIMed.d113.s959.orig_sentence: BAG-transfected 3T3 fibroblasts also exhibited prolonged cell survival in response to an apoptotic stimulus.

AIMed.d113.s960.sentence: The findings indicate that bag-1 represents a new type of anti-cell death gene and suggest that some routes of apoptosis induction previously ascribed to PROTEIN0-independent pathways may instead reflect a need for the combination of PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d113.s960.orig_sentence: The findings indicate that bag-1 represents a new type of anti-cell death gene and suggest that some routes of apoptosis induction previously ascribed to Bcl-2-independent pathways may instead reflect a need for the combination of Bcl-2 and BAG-1.

AIMed.d114.s961.sentence: PROTEIN0 binds to an alternatively spliced exon of PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d114.s961.orig_sentence: Syntrophin binds to an alternatively spliced exon of dystrophin.

AIMed.d114.s962.sentence: PROTEIN0, the protein product of the Duchenne muscular dystrophy locus, is a protein of the membrane cytoskeleton that associates with a complex of integral and membrane-associated proteins.
AIMed.d114.s962.orig_sentence: Dystrophin, the protein product of the Duchenne muscular dystrophy locus, is a protein of the membrane cytoskeleton that associates with a complex of integral and membrane-associated proteins.

AIMed.d114.s963.sentence: Of these, the 58-kD intracellular membrane-associated protein, syntrophin, was recently shown to consist of a family of three related but distinct genes.
AIMed.d114.s963.orig_sentence: Of these, the 58-kD intracellular membrane-associated protein, syntrophin, was recently shown to consist of a family of three related but distinct genes.

AIMed.d114.s964.sentence: We expressed the cDNA of human PROTEIN0 and the COOH terminus of human PROTEIN1 in reticulocyte lysates using an in vitro transcription/translation system.
AIMed.d114.s964.orig_sentence: We expressed the cDNA of human beta 1-syntrophin and the COOH terminus of human dystrophin in reticulocyte lysates using an in vitro transcription/translation system.

AIMed.d114.s965.sentence: Using antibodies to PROTEIN0 we immunoprecipitated these two interacting proteins in a variety of salt and detergent conditions.
AIMed.d114.s965.orig_sentence: Using antibodies to dystrophin we immunoprecipitated these two interacting proteins in a variety of salt and detergent conditions.

AIMed.d114.s966.sentence: We demonstrate that the 53 amino acids encoded on exon 74 of PROTEIN0, an alternatively spliced exon, are necessary and sufficient for interaction with translated PROTEIN1 in our assay.
AIMed.d114.s966.orig_sentence: We demonstrate that the 53 amino acids encoded on exon 74 of dystrophin, an alternatively spliced exon, are necessary and sufficient for interaction with translated beta 1-syntrophin in our assay.

AIMed.d114.s967.sentence: On the basis of its alternative splicing, PROTEIN0 may thus be present in two functionally distinct populations.
AIMed.d114.s967.orig_sentence: On the basis of its alternative splicing, dystrophin may thus be present in two functionally distinct populations.

AIMed.d114.s968.sentence: In this recombinant expression system, the PROTEIN0 relatives, human PROTEIN1 PROTEIN2 (PROTEIN3 or PROTEIN4) and the PROTEIN5 from Torpedo electric organ, also bind to translated PROTEIN6.
AIMed.d114.s968.orig_sentence: In this recombinant expression system, the dystrophin relatives, human dystrophin related protein (DRP or utrophin) and the 87K postsynaptic protein from Torpedo electric organ, also bind to translated beta 1-syntrophin.

AIMed.d114.s969.sentence: We have found a COOH-terminal 37-kD fragment of PROTEIN0 sufficient to interact with translated PROTEIN1 and its homologues, suggesting that the PROTEIN2 binding site on PROTEIN3 occurs on a region that is conserved among the three syntrophin homologues.
AIMed.d114.s969.orig_sentence: We have found a COOH-terminal 37-kD fragment of beta 1-syntrophin sufficient to interact with translated dystrophin and its homologues, suggesting that the dystrophin binding site on beta 1-syntrophin occurs on a region that is conserved among the three syntrophin homologues.

AIMed.d115.s970.sentence: Interaction with PROTEIN0 subunit of PROTEIN1 is required for transcriptional activation by PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d115.s970.orig_sentence: Interaction with RAP74 subunit of TFIIF is required for transcriptional activation by serum response factor.

AIMed.d115.s971.sentence: A few general transcription factors, in particular PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1, have been found to bind transcriptional activators.
AIMed.d115.s971.orig_sentence: A few general transcription factors, in particular TFIID and TFIIB, have been found to bind transcriptional activators.

AIMed.d115.s972.sentence: Here we show that the general transcription factor PROTEIN0 is also a target for a transcriptional activator, namely PROTEIN1 (PROTEIN2), which binds to the PROTEIN3 promoter.
AIMed.d115.s972.orig_sentence: Here we show that the general transcription factor TFIIF is also a target for a transcriptional activator, namely serum response factor (SRF), which binds to the c-fos promoter.

AIMed.d115.s973.sentence: Using a yeast interaction assay, we find that PROTEIN0 binds the PROTEIN1 subunit of PROTEIN2 and that PROTEIN3's transcriptional activation domain is the region involved in this binding.
AIMed.d115.s973.orig_sentence: Using a yeast interaction assay, we find that SRF binds the RAP74 subunit of TFIIF and that SRF's transcriptional activation domain is the region involved in this binding.

AIMed.d115.s974.sentence: Further, PROTEIN0's central charged cluster domain is required for binding to PROTEIN1's activation domain.
AIMed.d115.s974.orig_sentence: Further, RAP74's central charged cluster domain is required for binding to SRF's activation domain.

AIMed.d115.s975.sentence: Deletion of this domain impairs PROTEIN0's ability to support PROTEIN1-activated transcription in vitro but has little effect on the protein's basal transcription activity or its ability to support PROTEIN2-activated transcription.
AIMed.d115.s975.orig_sentence: Deletion of this domain impairs RAP74's ability to support SRF-activated transcription in vitro but has little effect on the protein's basal transcription activity or its ability to support SP1-activated transcription.

AIMed.d115.s976.sentence: The correlation of PROTEIN0-PROTEIN1 binding with transcriptional activation suggests that PROTEIN2 is a critical target for PROTEIN3-activated transcription.
AIMed.d115.s976.orig_sentence: The correlation of SRF-RAP74 binding with transcriptional activation suggests that RAP74 is a critical target for SRF-activated transcription.

AIMed.d116.s977.sentence: Activity of RNA polymerase I transcription factor PROTEIN0 blocked by PROTEIN1 gene product.
AIMed.d116.s977.orig_sentence: Activity of RNA polymerase I transcription factor UBF blocked by Rb gene product.

AIMed.d116.s978.sentence: The protein encoded by the PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1) functions as a tumour suppressor and negative growth regulator.
AIMed.d116.s978.orig_sentence: The protein encoded by the retinoblastoma susceptibility gene (Rb) functions as a tumour suppressor and negative growth regulator.

AIMed.d116.s979.sentence: As actively growing cells require the ongoing synthesis of ribosomal RNA, we considered that PROTEIN0 might interact with the ribosomal DNA transcription apparatus.
AIMed.d116.s979.orig_sentence: As actively growing cells require the ongoing synthesis of ribosomal RNA, we considered that Rb might interact with the ribosomal DNA transcription apparatus.

AIMed.d116.s980.sentence: Here we report that (1) there is an accumulation of PROTEIN0 protein in the nucleoli of differentiated U937 cells which correlates with inhibition of rDNA transcription; (2) addition of PROTEIN1 to an in vitro transcription system inhibits transcription by RNA polymerase I; (3) this inhibition requires a functional PROTEIN2 pocket; and (4) PROTEIN3 specifically inhibits the activity of the RNA polymerase I transcription factor PROTEIN4 (PROTEIN5) in vitro.
AIMed.d116.s980.orig_sentence: Here we report that (1) there is an accumulation of Rb protein in the nucleoli of differentiated U937 cells which correlates with inhibition of rDNA transcription; (2) addition of Rb to an in vitro transcription system inhibits transcription by RNA polymerase I; (3) this inhibition requires a functional Rb pocket; and (4) Rb specifically inhibits the activity of the RNA polymerase I transcription factor UBF (upstream binding factor) in vitro.

AIMed.d116.s981.sentence: This last observation was confirmed by affinity chromatography and immunoprecipitation, which demonstrated an interaction between PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d116.s981.orig_sentence: This last observation was confirmed by affinity chromatography and immunoprecipitation, which demonstrated an interaction between Rb and UBF.

AIMed.d116.s982.sentence: These results indicate that there is an additional mechanism by which PROTEIN0 suppresses cell growth, namely that PROTEIN1 directly represses transcription of the rRNA genes.
AIMed.d116.s982.orig_sentence: These results indicate that there is an additional mechanism by which Rb suppresses cell growth, namely that Rb directly represses transcription of the rRNA genes.

AIMed.d117.s983.sentence: PROTEIN0 antagonizes inhibition of liver cell growth by activin by a dominant-negative mechanism.
AIMed.d117.s983.orig_sentence: Inhibin antagonizes inhibition of liver cell growth by activin by a dominant-negative mechanism.

AIMed.d117.s984.sentence: The beta:PROTEIN0 homodimer and alpha:PROTEIN1 heterodimer are mutual antagonists which share a common beta subunit.
AIMed.d117.s984.orig_sentence: The beta:beta activin homodimer and alpha:beta inhibin heterodimer are mutual antagonists which share a common beta subunit.

AIMed.d117.s985.sentence: Recently, it has been shown that, similar to PROTEIN0, activin is an inhibitor of hepatocyte DNA synthesis.
AIMed.d117.s985.orig_sentence: Recently, it has been shown that, similar to transforming growth factor-beta 1, activin is an inhibitor of hepatocyte DNA synthesis.

AIMed.d117.s986.sentence: The activin receptor appears to be an obligatory complex of genetically distinct type I and II transmembrane serine/threonine kinases.
AIMed.d117.s986.orig_sentence: The activin receptor appears to be an obligatory complex of genetically distinct type I and II transmembrane serine/threonine kinases.

AIMed.d117.s987.sentence: Activin type I receptors, PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1, were first cloned from well differentiated human hepatoma cells (HepG2).
AIMed.d117.s987.orig_sentence: Activin type I receptors, SKR1 and SKR2, were first cloned from well differentiated human hepatoma cells (HepG2).

AIMed.d117.s988.sentence: This prompted us to investigate the binding of activin and inhibin to receptors from HepG2 cells and the effect of the two ligands on DNA synthesis.
AIMed.d117.s988.orig_sentence: This prompted us to investigate the binding of activin and inhibin to receptors from HepG2 cells and the effect of the two ligands on DNA synthesis.

AIMed.d117.s989.sentence: Here we show that beta:PROTEIN0 binds to the PROTEIN1 (PROTEIN2) which induces activin binding to the type I receptor kinase PROTEIN3 to form PROTEIN4.beta:beta.
AIMed.d117.s989.orig_sentence: Here we show that beta:beta activin binds to the activin type II receptor kinase (ActRII) which induces activin binding to the type I receptor kinase SKR2 to form ActRII.beta:beta.

AIMed.d117.s990.sentence: PROTEIN0 complexes in which an PROTEIN1 chain occupies each receptor subunit.
AIMed.d117.s990.orig_sentence: SKR2 complexes in which an activin beta chain occupies each receptor subunit.

AIMed.d117.s991.sentence: PROTEIN0 also binds to PROTEIN1 through its beta subunit, competes with the binding of activin to PROTEIN2, but fails to form the PROTEIN3.
AIMed.d117.s991.orig_sentence: Inhibin also binds to ActRII through its beta subunit, competes with the binding of activin to ActRII, but fails to form the ActRII.

AIMed.d117.s993.sentence: No specific binding site for inhibin could be demonstrated in HepG2 cells.
AIMed.d117.s993.orig_sentence: No specific binding site for inhibin could be demonstrated in HepG2 cells.

AIMed.d117.s994.sentence: PROTEIN0, which had no activity of its own, antagonized the inhibitory effect of activin on DNA synthesis.
AIMed.d117.s994.orig_sentence: Inhibin, which had no activity of its own, antagonized the inhibitory effect of activin on DNA synthesis.

AIMed.d117.s995.sentence: The results suggest that inhibin may be a natural antagonist of assembly of the heterodimeric PROTEIN0 complex through a dominant-negative mechanism.
AIMed.d117.s995.orig_sentence: The results suggest that inhibin may be a natural antagonist of assembly of the heterodimeric activin receptor complex through a dominant-negative mechanism.

AIMed.d118.s996.sentence: The PROTEIN0 inhibitor of cyclin-dependent kinases controls DNA replication by interaction with PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d118.s996.orig_sentence: The p21 inhibitor of cyclin-dependent kinases controls DNA replication by interaction with PCNA.

AIMed.d118.s997.sentence: The PROTEIN0 tumour-suppressor protein controls the expression of a gene encoding the PROTEIN1 cyclin-dependent protein kinase (CDK) regulator.
AIMed.d118.s997.orig_sentence: The p53 tumour-suppressor protein controls the expression of a gene encoding the p21 cyclin-dependent protein kinase (CDK) regulator.

AIMed.d118.s998.sentence: Levels of PROTEIN0 protein are increased in senescent cells and PROTEIN1 overexpression blocks the growth of tumour cells.
AIMed.d118.s998.orig_sentence: Levels of p21 protein are increased in senescent cells and p21 overexpression blocks the growth of tumour cells.

AIMed.d118.s999.sentence: In normal human cells, but not in many tumour cells, PROTEIN0 exists in a quaternary complex with a cyclin, a CDK, and the PROTEIN1 (PROTEIN2).
AIMed.d118.s999.orig_sentence: In normal human cells, but not in many tumour cells, p21 exists in a quaternary complex with a cyclin, a CDK, and the proliferating-cell nuclear antigen (PCNA).

AIMed.d118.s1000.sentence: PROTEIN0 controls CDK activity, thereby affecting cell-cycle control, whereas PROTEIN1 functions in both DNA replication and repair.
AIMed.d118.s1000.orig_sentence: p21 controls CDK activity, thereby affecting cell-cycle control, whereas PCNA functions in both DNA replication and repair.

AIMed.d118.s1001.sentence: Here we use simian virus 40 DNA replication in vitro to show than PROTEIN0 directly inhibits PROTEIN1-dependent DNA replication in the absence of a cyclin/CDK.
AIMed.d118.s1001.orig_sentence: Here we use simian virus 40 DNA replication in vitro to show than p21 directly inhibits PCNA-dependent DNA replication in the absence of a cyclin/CDK.

AIMed.d118.s1002.sentence: Furthermore, PROTEIN0 blocks the ability of PROTEIN1 to activate PROTEIN2, the principal replicative DNA polymerase.
AIMed.d118.s1002.orig_sentence: Furthermore, p21 blocks the ability of PCNA to activate DNA polymerase delta, the principal replicative DNA polymerase.

AIMed.d118.s1003.sentence: This regulation results from a direct interaction between PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d118.s1003.orig_sentence: This regulation results from a direct interaction between p21 and PCNA.

AIMed.d118.s1004.sentence: Thus, during PROTEIN0-mediated suppression of cell proliferation, PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2 may be important for coordinating cell-cycle progression, DNA replication and repair of damaged DNA.
AIMed.d118.s1004.orig_sentence: Thus, during p53-mediated suppression of cell proliferation, p21 and PCNA may be important for coordinating cell-cycle progression, DNA replication and repair of damaged DNA.

AIMed.d119.s1005.sentence: Nuclear protein PROTEIN0 is a coactivator for the transcription factor PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d119.s1005.orig_sentence: Nuclear protein CBP is a coactivator for the transcription factor CREB.

AIMed.d119.s1006.sentence: The transcription factor PROTEIN0 binds to a DNA element known as the cAMP-regulated enhancer (CRE).
AIMed.d119.s1006.orig_sentence: The transcription factor CREB binds to a DNA element known as the cAMP-regulated enhancer (CRE).

AIMed.d119.s1007.sentence: PROTEIN0 is activated through phosphorylation by PROTEIN1 (PROTEIN2), but precisely how phosphorylation stimulates PROTEIN3 function is unknown.
AIMed.d119.s1007.orig_sentence: CREB is activated through phosphorylation by protein kinase A (PKA), but precisely how phosphorylation stimulates CREB function is unknown.

AIMed.d119.s1008.sentence: One model is that phosphorylation may allow the recruitment of coactivators which then interact with basal transcription factors.
AIMed.d119.s1008.orig_sentence: One model is that phosphorylation may allow the recruitment of coactivators which then interact with basal transcription factors.

AIMed.d119.s1009.sentence: We have previously identified a nuclear protein of M(r)265K, PROTEIN0, that binds specifically to the PROTEIN1-phosphorylated form of PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d119.s1009.orig_sentence: We have previously identified a nuclear protein of M(r)265K, CBP, that binds specifically to the PKA-phosphorylated form of CREB.

AIMed.d119.s1010.sentence: We have used fluorescence anisotropy measurements to define the equilibrium binding parameters of the PROTEIN0:PROTEIN1 interaction and report here that PROTEIN2 can activate transcription through a region in its carboxy terminus.
AIMed.d119.s1010.orig_sentence: We have used fluorescence anisotropy measurements to define the equilibrium binding parameters of the phosphoCREB:CBP interaction and report here that CBP can activate transcription through a region in its carboxy terminus.

AIMed.d119.s1011.sentence: The activation domain of PROTEIN0 interacts with the basal transcription factor PROTEIN1 through a domain that is conserved in the yeast coactivator PROTEIN2 (ref. 8).
AIMed.d119.s1011.orig_sentence: The activation domain of CBP interacts with the basal transcription factor TFIIB through a domain that is conserved in the yeast coactivator ADA-1 (ref. 8).

AIMed.d119.s1012.sentence: Consistent with its role as a coactivator, PROTEIN0 augments the activity of phosphorylated PROTEIN1 to activate transcription of cAMP-responsive genes.
AIMed.d119.s1012.orig_sentence: Consistent with its role as a coactivator, CBP augments the activity of phosphorylated CREB to activate transcription of cAMP-responsive genes.

AIMed.d120.s1013.sentence: Specific binding of the transglutaminase, PROTEIN0, to PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d120.s1013.orig_sentence: Specific binding of the transglutaminase, platelet factor XIII, to HSP27.

AIMed.d120.s1014.sentence: PROTEIN0, the unique mammalian low molecular weight heat shock protein, is prominently phosphorylated upon activation of a wide variety of cells and has a role in thermotolerance, growth events, and regulation of actin cytoskeletal dynamics.
AIMed.d120.s1014.orig_sentence: HSP27, the unique mammalian low molecular weight heat shock protein, is prominently phosphorylated upon activation of a wide variety of cells and has a role in thermotolerance, growth events, and regulation of actin cytoskeletal dynamics.

AIMed.d120.s1015.sentence: In thrombin-stimulated platelets, PROTEIN0 is rapidly and prominently phosphorylated in a manner highly correlated with platelet secretion.
AIMed.d120.s1015.orig_sentence: In thrombin-stimulated platelets, HSP27 is rapidly and prominently phosphorylated in a manner highly correlated with platelet secretion.

AIMed.d120.s1016.sentence: However, the function of PROTEIN0 and the identity of proteins that interact with PROTEIN1 remain unknown.
AIMed.d120.s1016.orig_sentence: However, the function of HSP27 and the identity of proteins that interact with HSP27 remain unknown.

AIMed.d120.s1017.sentence: To identify specific PROTEIN0-protein interactions, a recombinant fusion protein affinity reagent was constructed and used to identify proteins associating with PROTEIN1 from human platelet lysates and erythroleukemia cells.
AIMed.d120.s1017.orig_sentence: To identify specific HSP27-protein interactions, a recombinant fusion protein affinity reagent was constructed and used to identify proteins associating with HSP27 from human platelet lysates and erythroleukemia cells.

AIMed.d120.s1018.sentence: An 84-kDa protein was found to associate specifically with PROTEIN0 and was isolated from platelet lysates, resolved on preparative gels, transferred to nitrocellulose, subjected to enzymatic digestion, and microsequenced.
AIMed.d120.s1018.orig_sentence: An 84-kDa protein was found to associate specifically with HSP27 and was isolated from platelet lysates, resolved on preparative gels, transferred to nitrocellulose, subjected to enzymatic digestion, and microsequenced.

AIMed.d120.s1019.sentence: A 20-amino acid sequence derived from p84 proved identical to amino acids 484-503 of the transglutaminase, platelet Factor XIII.
AIMed.d120.s1019.orig_sentence: A 20-amino acid sequence derived from p84 proved identical to amino acids 484-503 of the transglutaminase, platelet Factor XIII.

AIMed.d120.s1020.sentence: Immunoblotting studies were used to confirm the binding of PROTEIN0 from fresh platelet lysates to the PROTEIN1 fusion protein.
AIMed.d120.s1020.orig_sentence: Immunoblotting studies were used to confirm the binding of FXIII from fresh platelet lysates to the HSP27 fusion protein.

AIMed.d120.s1021.sentence: PROTEIN0 also was shown to coprecipitate with PROTEIN1 in immunoprecipitation studies and to colocalize with PROTEIN2 in immunofluorescence studies of intact glass-activated platelets.
AIMed.d120.s1021.orig_sentence: FXIII also was shown to coprecipitate with HSP27 in immunoprecipitation studies and to colocalize with HSP27 in immunofluorescence studies of intact glass-activated platelets.

AIMed.d120.s1022.sentence: The data thus demonstrate specific binding of platelet PROTEIN0 to PROTEIN1 and suggest that PROTEIN2 may participate in the cellular localization and/or enzymatic regulation of platelet PROTEIN3.
AIMed.d120.s1022.orig_sentence: The data thus demonstrate specific binding of platelet FXIII to HSP27 and suggest that HSP27 may participate in the cellular localization and/or enzymatic regulation of platelet FXIII.

AIMed.d121.s1023.sentence: Several hydrophobic amino acids in the PROTEIN0 amino-terminal domain are required for transcriptional activation, binding to PROTEIN1 and the adenovirus PROTEIN2 PROTEIN3 55-kD protein.
AIMed.d121.s1023.orig_sentence: Several hydrophobic amino acids in the p53 amino-terminal domain are required for transcriptional activation, binding to mdm-2 and the adenovirus 5 E1B 55-kD protein.

AIMed.d121.s1024.sentence: The PROTEIN0 tumor suppressor gene product is a transcriptional activator that may be associated with its ability to suppress tumor cell growth.
AIMed.d121.s1024.orig_sentence: The p53 tumor suppressor gene product is a transcriptional activator that may be associated with its ability to suppress tumor cell growth.

AIMed.d121.s1025.sentence: The acidic amino terminus of the PROTEIN0 protein has been shown to contain this trans-activation activity as well as the domains for PROTEIN1 and adenovirus PROTEIN2 PROTEIN3 55-kD protein binding.
AIMed.d121.s1025.orig_sentence: The acidic amino terminus of the p53 protein has been shown to contain this trans-activation activity as well as the domains for mdm-2 and adenovirus 5 E1B 55-kD protein binding.

AIMed.d121.s1026.sentence: An extensive genetic analysis of this amino-terminal PROTEIN0 domain has been undertaken using site-specific mutagenesis.
AIMed.d121.s1026.orig_sentence: An extensive genetic analysis of this amino-terminal p53 domain has been undertaken using site-specific mutagenesis.

AIMed.d121.s1027.sentence: The results demonstrate that the acidic residues in the amino terminus of PROTEIN0 may contribute to, but are not critical for, this trans-activation activity.
AIMed.d121.s1027.orig_sentence: The results demonstrate that the acidic residues in the amino terminus of p53 may contribute to, but are not critical for, this trans-activation activity.

AIMed.d121.s1028.sentence: Rather, the hydrophobic amino acid residues Leu-22 and Trp-23 of human PROTEIN0 are both required for trans-activation activity, binding to the adenovirus PROTEIN1 55-kD protein and the human PROTEIN2-PROTEIN3 protein in vitro.
AIMed.d121.s1028.orig_sentence: Rather, the hydrophobic amino acid residues Leu-22 and Trp-23 of human p53 are both required for trans-activation activity, binding to the adenovirus E1B 55-kD protein and the human mdm-2-p53 protein in vitro.

AIMed.d121.s1029.sentence: In addition, hydrophobic residues Leu-14 and Phe-19 are crucial for the interactions between PROTEIN0 and human PROTEIN1 (PROTEIN2).
AIMed.d121.s1029.orig_sentence: In addition, hydrophobic residues Leu-14 and Phe-19 are crucial for the interactions between p53 and human mdm-2 (hdm-2).

AIMed.d121.s1030.sentence: Hydrophobic residues Trp-23 and Pro-27 are also important for binding to the adenovirus 5 (Ad5) PROTEIN0 55-kD protein in vitro.
AIMed.d121.s1030.orig_sentence: Hydrophobic residues Trp-23 and Pro-27 are also important for binding to the adenovirus 5 (Ad5) E1B 55-kD protein in vitro.

AIMed.d121.s1031.sentence: These mutations have no impact on the ability of the PROTEIN0 protein to bind to a PROTEIN1-specific DNA element.
AIMed.d121.s1031.orig_sentence: These mutations have no impact on the ability of the p53 protein to bind to a p53-specific DNA element.

AIMed.d121.s1032.sentence: These results suggest that 2-4 critical hydrophobic residues in the amino-terminal domain of the PROTEIN0 protein interact with the transcriptional machinery of the cell resulting in transcriptional activation.
AIMed.d121.s1032.orig_sentence: These results suggest that 2-4 critical hydrophobic residues in the amino-terminal domain of the p53 protein interact with the transcriptional machinery of the cell resulting in transcriptional activation.

AIMed.d121.s1033.sentence: These very same hydrophobic residues contact the PROTEIN0 and Ad5 PROTEIN1 55-kD oncogene products.
AIMed.d121.s1033.orig_sentence: These very same hydrophobic residues contact the hdm-2 and Ad5 E1B 55-kD oncogene products.

AIMed.d122.s1034.sentence: Type II regulatory subunit (RII) of the cAMP-dependent protein kinase interaction with A-kinase anchor proteins requires isoleucines 3 and 5.
AIMed.d122.s1034.orig_sentence: Type II regulatory subunit (RII) of the cAMP-dependent protein kinase interaction with A-kinase anchor proteins requires isoleucines 3 and 5.

AIMed.d122.s1040.orig_sentence: Mutation of both isoleucines decreased AKAP binding without affecting dimerization, cAMP binding, or the overall secondary structure of the protein.

AIMed.d123.s1043.orig_sentence: Characterization of an interaction between insulin receptor substrate 1 and the insulin receptor by using the two-hybrid system.

AIMed.d123.s1044.sentence: PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1) is a major substrate of the PROTEIN2 and has been implicated in PROTEIN3 signaling.

AIMed.d123.s1046.orig_sentence: In this study, we used the two-hybrid assay of protein-protein interaction in the yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae to study the interaction between human IRS-1 and the insulin receptor.

AIMed.d123.s1048.sentence: We show that the interaction is strictly dependent upon receptor tyrosine kinase activity, since PROTEIN0 shows no interaction with a kinase-inactive receptor hybrid containing a mutated ATP-binding site.

AIMed.d123.s1049.sentence: Furthermore, mutation of receptor tyrosine 960 to phenylalanine eliminates PROTEIN0 interaction in the two-hybrid assay.

AIMed.d123.s1050.sentence: These data suggest that the interaction between PROTEIN0 and the receptor is direct and provide evidence that the juxtamembrane domain of the receptor is involved.

AIMed.d123.s1051.sentence: Furthermore, we show that a 356-amino-acid region encompassed by amino acids 160 through 516 of PROTEIN0 is sufficient for interaction with the receptor in the two-hybrid assay.

AIMed.d123.s1052.sentence: Lastly, in agreement with our findings for yeast cells, we show that the PROTEIN0 is unable to phosphorylate an PROTEIN1 protein containing a deletion of amino acids 45 to 516 when expressed in COS cells.

AIMed.d123.s1053.sentence: The two-hybrid assay should provide a facile means by which to pursue a detailed understanding of this interaction.

AIMed.d125.s1063.orig_sentence: Fusion proteins were created by linking Bcl-2 family proteins to a LexA DNA-binding domain or a B42 trans-activation domain.

AIMed.d125.s1068.sentence: Use of deletion mutants of PROTEIN0 suggested that PROTEIN1 homodimerization involves interactions between two distinct regions within the PROTEIN2 protein, since a LexA protein containing PROTEIN3 amino acids 83-218 mediated functional interactions with a B42 fusion protein containing PROTEIN4 amino acids 1-81 but did not complement a B42 fusion protein containing PROTEIN5 amino acids 83-218.

AIMed.d126.s1072.sentence: The rates of commitment to renaturation of PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 in the presence of the groE chaperonins.
AIMed.d126.s1072.orig_sentence: The rates of commitment to renaturation of rhodanese and glutamine synthetase in the presence of the groE chaperonins.

AIMed.d126.s1074.orig_sentence: Using immunoprecipitation techniques, we have determined the rates at which rhodanese and glutamine synthetase (GS) are released from groEL in a form committed to refold to active enzyme.

AIMed.d126.s1078.sentence: At 25 degrees C, the rate profiles indicate the release and commitment to folding of PROTEIN0 to its native state occurs far earlier (t1/2 < 1 min) than for PROTEIN1 (t1/2 = 5 min).

AIMed.d126.s1079.sentence: In light of previous results, it appears that PROTEIN0 monomers can attain a groE-independent assembly competent conformation after a brief interaction with the chaperonin.
AIMed.d126.s1079.orig_sentence: In light of previous results, it appears that GS monomers can attain a groE-independent assembly competent conformation after a brief interaction with the chaperonin.

AIMed.d126.s1080.sentence: In contrast, the renaturation rate for PROTEIN0 with the groE chaperonins mirrored the committed renaturation rates following PROTEIN1 depletion.
AIMed.d126.s1080.orig_sentence: In contrast, the renaturation rate for rhodanese with the groE chaperonins mirrored the committed renaturation rates following groEL depletion.

AIMed.d126.s1081.sentence: This suggests that PROTEIN0 must interact with PROTEIN1 throughout most of its folding reaction before it acquires a folding competent (groE independent) state.
AIMed.d126.s1081.orig_sentence: This suggests that rhodanese must interact with groEL throughout most of its folding reaction before it acquires a folding competent (groE independent) state.

AIMed.d126.s1082.sentence: If current models of chaperonin mechanism are correct, PROTEIN0 undergoes more rebinding and release cycles than does PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d126.s1082.orig_sentence: If current models of chaperonin mechanism are correct, rhodanese undergoes more rebinding and release cycles than does GS.

AIMed.d126.s1083.sentence: Structurally, the degree of cycling and hence the rate of commitment to folding to the active form are probably dictated by the hydrophobic nature, number, and lifetimes of the folding intermediates that interact with the chaperonins.

AIMed.d127.s1084.orig_sentence: Interaction of IL-2R beta and gamma c chains with Jak1 and Jak3: implications for XSCID and XCID.

AIMed.d128.s1092.sentence: The human pituitary hormones, PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1) and PROTEIN2 (PROTEIN3), regulate a large variety of physiological processes, among which are growth and differentiation of muscle, bone and cartilage cells, and lactation.
AIMed.d128.s1092.orig_sentence: The human pituitary hormones, growth hormone (hGH) and prolactin (hPRL), regulate a large variety of physiological processes, among which are growth and differentiation of muscle, bone and cartilage cells, and lactation.

AIMed.d128.s1094.sentence: The PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 receptors (PROTEIN2 and PROTEIN3, respectively) are single-pass transmembrane receptors from class 1 of the haematopoietic receptor superfamily.

AIMed.d128.s1095.sentence: This classification is based on sequence similarity in their extracellular domains, notably a highly conserved pentapeptide, the so-called 'WSXWS box', the function of which is controversial.

AIMed.d128.s1096.sentence: All ligands in class 1 activate their respective receptors by clustering mechanisms.

AIMed.d132.s1128.sentence: Functional participation of the PROTEIN0 PROTEIN1 chain in PROTEIN2 PROTEIN3 complexes.
AIMed.d132.s1128.orig_sentence: Functional participation of the IL-2 receptor gamma chain in IL-7 receptor complexes.

AIMed.d132.s1129.sentence: The gamma chain of the PROTEIN0 PROTEIN1 PROTEIN2 is shared with the functional PROTEIN3 PROTEIN4 and is causatively related to X-linked severe combined immunodeficiency (XSCID), which is ascribed to a profound T cell defect.

AIMed.d132.s1130.sentence: Studies with monoclonal antibodies specific for the PROTEIN0 receptor gamma chain showed that the gamma chain participates in the functional high-affinity receptor complexes for PROTEIN1 that are involved in the differentiation of T and B cells.
AIMed.d132.s1130.orig_sentence: Studies with monoclonal antibodies specific for the IL-2 receptor gamma chain showed that the gamma chain participates in the functional high-affinity receptor complexes for IL-7 that are involved in the differentiation of T and B cells.

AIMed.d132.s1131.sentence: Participation of the gamma subunit in more than one receptor may enable the elucidation of the mechanisms of XSCID development and lymphocyte differentiation.

AIMed.d135.s1147.sentence: Tumor necrosis factor (TNF) and PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1) are members of a family of secreted and cell surface cytokines that participate in the regulation of immune and inflammatory responses.
AIMed.d135.s1147.orig_sentence: Tumor necrosis factor (TNF) and lymphotoxin-alpha (LT-alpha) are members of a family of secreted and cell surface cytokines that participate in the regulation of immune and inflammatory responses.

AIMed.d135.s1148.sentence: The cell surface form of PROTEIN0 is assembled during biosynthesis as a heteromeric complex with PROTEIN1 (PROTEIN2), a type II transmembrane protein that is another member of the TNF ligand family.
AIMed.d135.s1148.orig_sentence: The cell surface form of LT-alpha is assembled during biosynthesis as a heteromeric complex with lymphotoxin-beta (LT-beta), a type II transmembrane protein that is another member of the TNF ligand family.

AIMed.d135.s1149.sentence: Secreted PROTEIN0 is a homotrimer that binds to distinct TNF receptors of 60 and 80 kilodaltons; however, these receptors do not recognize the major cell surface PROTEIN1-PROTEIN2 complex.
AIMed.d135.s1149.orig_sentence: Secreted LT-alpha is a homotrimer that binds to distinct TNF receptors of 60 and 80 kilodaltons; however, these receptors do not recognize the major cell surface LT-alpha-LT-beta complex.

AIMed.d135.s1150.sentence: A receptor specific for human PROTEIN0 was identified, which suggests that cell surface LT may have functions that are distinct from those of secreted PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d135.s1150.orig_sentence: A receptor specific for human LT-beta was identified, which suggests that cell surface LT may have functions that are distinct from those of secreted LT-alpha.

AIMed.d136.s1151.sentence: Cloning of a T cell growth factor that interacts with the beta chain of the PROTEIN0.
AIMed.d136.s1151.orig_sentence: Cloning of a T cell growth factor that interacts with the beta chain of the interleukin-2 receptor.

AIMed.d136.s1152.sentence: A cytokine was identified that stimulated the proliferation of T lymphocytes, and a complementary DNA clone encoding this new T cell growth factor was isolated.
AIMed.d136.s1152.orig_sentence: A cytokine was identified that stimulated the proliferation of T lymphocytes, and a complementary DNA clone encoding this new T cell growth factor was isolated.

AIMed.d136.s1153.sentence: The cytokine, designated PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1), is produced by a wide variety of cells and tissues and shares many biological properties with PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d136.s1153.orig_sentence: The cytokine, designated interleukin-15 (IL-15), is produced by a wide variety of cells and tissues and shares many biological properties with IL-2.

AIMed.d136.s1154.sentence: Monoclonal antibodies to the beta chain of the PROTEIN0 receptor inhibited the biological activity of PROTEIN1, and PROTEIN2 competed for binding with PROTEIN3, indicating that PROTEIN4 uses components of the PROTEIN5 PROTEIN6.
AIMed.d136.s1154.orig_sentence: Monoclonal antibodies to the beta chain of the IL-2 receptor inhibited the biological activity of IL-15, and IL-15 competed for binding with IL-2, indicating that IL-15 uses components of the IL-2 receptor.

AIMed.d137.s1155.sentence: The POU domains of the PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 transcription factors mediate specific interaction with PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d137.s1155.orig_sentence: The POU domains of the Oct1 and Oct2 transcription factors mediate specific interaction with TBP.

AIMed.d137.s1156.sentence: We had previously shown that the ubiquitous PROTEIN0 and the lymphoid-specific PROTEIN1 transcription factors stimulate transcription at the level of stable preinitiation complex formation.
AIMed.d137.s1156.orig_sentence: We had previously shown that the ubiquitous Oct1 and the lymphoid-specific Oct2 transcription factors stimulate transcription at the level of stable preinitiation complex formation.

AIMed.d137.s1157.sentence: We have therefore investigated whether the octamer binding proteins might physically interact with PROTEIN0, the PROTEIN1 component of the PROTEIN2 factor.
AIMed.d137.s1157.orig_sentence: We have therefore investigated whether the octamer binding proteins might physically interact with TBP, the TATA box binding protein component of the TFIID factor.

AIMed.d137.s1158.sentence: By using several different experimental systems we show that PROTEIN0 efficiently associates with PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d137.s1158.orig_sentence: By using several different experimental systems we show that TBP efficiently associates with Oct1 and Oct2.

AIMed.d137.s1159.sentence: The interaction is direct and does not depend on the presence of DNA or additional proteins.
AIMed.d137.s1159.orig_sentence: The interaction is direct and does not depend on the presence of DNA or additional proteins.

AIMed.d137.s1160.sentence: N- and C-terminal deletions of the different proteins were used to localize the domains involved in the interaction.
AIMed.d137.s1160.orig_sentence: N- and C-terminal deletions of the different proteins were used to localize the domains involved in the interaction.

AIMed.d137.s1161.sentence: We show that the POU homeodomain of PROTEIN0 and the evolutionarily conserved C-terminal core domain of PROTEIN1 are both required and sufficient for the interaction.
AIMed.d137.s1161.orig_sentence: We show that the POU homeodomain of Oct2 and the evolutionarily conserved C-terminal core domain of TBP are both required and sufficient for the interaction.

AIMed.d137.s1162.sentence: The PROTEIN0 POU domain, which is highly homologous to the PROTEIN1 POU domain, likewise mediates interaction with PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d137.s1162.orig_sentence: The Oct1 POU domain, which is highly homologous to the Oct2 POU domain, likewise mediates interaction with TBP.

AIMed.d137.s1163.sentence: The interaction can also be observed in vivo, as PROTEIN0 can be co-precipitated with PROTEIN1 from co-transfected Cos1 cells and PROTEIN2 co-immunoprecipitates with the endogenous PROTEIN3 from HeLa cells.
AIMed.d137.s1163.orig_sentence: The interaction can also be observed in vivo, as TBP can be co-precipitated with Oct2 from co-transfected Cos1 cells and TBP co-immunoprecipitates with the endogenous Oct1 from HeLa cells.

AIMed.d137.s1164.sentence: Co-transfection of human PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 expression vectors into B cells resulted in a synergistic activation of an octamer motif containing promoter.
AIMed.d137.s1164.orig_sentence: Co-transfection of human TBP and Oct2 expression vectors into B cells resulted in a synergistic activation of an octamer motif containing promoter.

AIMed.d138.s1165.sentence: Interaction of mammalian splicing factor PROTEIN0 with PROTEIN1 and relation of its 60-kD subunit to yeast PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d138.s1165.orig_sentence: Interaction of mammalian splicing factor SF3a with U2 snRNP and relation of its 60-kD subunit to yeast PRP9.

AIMed.d138.s1166.sentence: In the assembly of a prespliceosome, PROTEIN0 (snRNP) functions in pre-messenger RNA (mRNA) splicing together with splicing factors (SFs) 3a, PROTEIN1, and several other proteins.
AIMed.d138.s1166.orig_sentence: In the assembly of a prespliceosome, U2 small nuclear ribonucleoprotein (snRNP) functions in pre-messenger RNA (mRNA) splicing together with splicing factors (SFs) 3a, SF3b, and several other proteins.

AIMed.d138.s1167.sentence: The 17S but not the 12S form of PROTEIN0 is active in splicing-complex formation.
AIMed.d138.s1167.orig_sentence: The 17S but not the 12S form of U2 snRNP is active in splicing-complex formation.

AIMed.d138.s1168.sentence: Here it is shown that the PROTEIN0 subunits correspond to three of the 17S PROTEIN1-specific polypeptides.
AIMed.d138.s1168.orig_sentence: Here it is shown that the SF3a subunits correspond to three of the 17S U2 snRNP-specific polypeptides.

AIMed.d138.s1169.sentence: PROTEIN0 interacts with PROTEIN1 in the presence of PROTEIN2 to generate a structure similar to 17S PROTEIN3, which suggests a function for PROTEIN4 and PROTEIN5 in the incorporation of PROTEIN6 into the spliceosome.
AIMed.d138.s1169.orig_sentence: SF3a interacts with U2 snRNP in the presence of SF3b to generate a structure similar to 17S U2 snRNP, which suggests a function for SF3a and SF3b in the incorporation of U2 snRNP into the spliceosome.

AIMed.d138.s1170.sentence: Furthermore, the 60-kilodalton subunit of PROTEIN0 is related to the yeast splicing protein PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d138.s1170.orig_sentence: Furthermore, the 60-kilodalton subunit of SF3a is related to the yeast splicing protein PRP9.

AIMed.d139.s1171.sentence: PROTEIN0. an Ala-->Gly substitution in helix 1 of PROTEIN1 repeat 17 that severely disrupts the structure and self-association of the erythrocyte spectrin heterodimer.
AIMed.d139.s1171.orig_sentence: Spectrin cagliari. an Ala-->Gly substitution in helix 1 of beta spectrin repeat 17 that severely disrupts the structure and self-association of the erythrocyte spectrin heterodimer.
