AIMed.d139.s1172.orig_sentence: The spectrin tetramer, the principal structural element of the red cell membrane skeleton, is formed by stable head-to-head self-association of two spectrin heterodimers.

AIMed.d139.s1173.sentence: The self-association site appears to be formed by interactions between helices 1 and 2 of PROTEIN0 repeat 17 of one dimer with helix 3 of PROTEIN1 repeat 1 of the other dimer to form two combined alpha-beta triple-helical segments.
AIMed.d139.s1173.orig_sentence: The self-association site appears to be formed by interactions between helices 1 and 2 of beta spectrin repeat 17 of one dimer with helix 3 of alpha spectrin repeat 1 of the other dimer to form two combined alpha-beta triple-helical segments.

AIMed.d139.s1174.sentence: The head of the heterodimer appears to involve similar intradimer interactions.
AIMed.d139.s1174.orig_sentence: The head of the heterodimer appears to involve similar intradimer interactions.

AIMed.d139.s1175.sentence: We describe the first example of an amino acid substitution in helix 1 of this combined alpha-beta triple-helical segment, which, although relatively minor, profoundly impairs tetramer formation.
AIMed.d139.s1175.orig_sentence: We describe the first example of an amino acid substitution in helix 1 of this combined alpha-beta triple-helical segment, which, although relatively minor, profoundly impairs tetramer formation.

AIMed.d139.s1176.sentence: Strikingly, low angle rotary shadowing electron microscopy of isolated spectrin dimers reveals that this mutation also severely disrupts the head of the heterodimer causing it to be open.
AIMed.d139.s1176.orig_sentence: Strikingly, low angle rotary shadowing electron microscopy of isolated spectrin dimers reveals that this mutation also severely disrupts the head of the heterodimer causing it to be open.

AIMed.d139.s1177.sentence: Following linkage studies which were most consistent with a PROTEIN0 gene mutation, a nucleotide change was identified in codon 2018, resulting in an Ala-->Gly substitution in the first helical domain of PROTEIN1 repeat 17.
AIMed.d139.s1177.orig_sentence: Following linkage studies which were most consistent with a beta spectrin gene mutation, a nucleotide change was identified in codon 2018, resulting in an Ala-->Gly substitution in the first helical domain of beta spectrin repeat 17.

AIMed.d139.s1178.sentence: Because glycine is a strong helix breaker, this change is predicted to disrupt the conformation of this helical domain.
AIMed.d139.s1178.orig_sentence: Because glycine is a strong helix breaker, this change is predicted to disrupt the conformation of this helical domain.

AIMed.d139.s1179.sentence: Our results indicate that this helical domain must play direct roles in the alpha-beta interdimer interactions that form the self-association site of the tetramer and in the alpha-beta intradimer interactions at the head of the heterodimer.
AIMed.d139.s1179.orig_sentence: Our results indicate that this helical domain must play direct roles in the alpha-beta interdimer interactions that form the self-association site of the tetramer and in the alpha-beta intradimer interactions at the head of the heterodimer.

AIMed.d141.s1188.sentence: The PROTEIN0 Cdk-interacting protein PROTEIN1 is a potent inhibitor of G1 cyclin-dependent kinases.
AIMed.d141.s1188.orig_sentence: The p21 Cdk-interacting protein Cip1 is a potent inhibitor of G1 cyclin-dependent kinases.

AIMed.d141.s1189.sentence: The cyclin-dependent kinase PROTEIN0 associates with PROTEIN1, D, and E and has been implicated in the control of the G1 to S phase transition in mammals.
AIMed.d141.s1189.orig_sentence: The cyclin-dependent kinase Cdk2 associates with cyclins A, D, and E and has been implicated in the control of the G1 to S phase transition in mammals.

AIMed.d141.s1190.sentence: To identify potential PROTEIN0 regulators, we have employed an improved two-hybrid system to isolate human genes encoding Cdk-interacting proteins (Cips).
AIMed.d141.s1190.orig_sentence: To identify potential Cdk2 regulators, we have employed an improved two-hybrid system to isolate human genes encoding Cdk-interacting proteins (Cips).

AIMed.d141.s1191.sentence: PROTEIN0 encodes a novel 21 kd protein that is found in PROTEIN1, PROTEIN2, PROTEIN3, and PROTEIN4 immunoprecipitates.
AIMed.d141.s1191.orig_sentence: CIP1 encodes a novel 21 kd protein that is found in cyclin A, cyclin D1, cyclin E, and Cdk2 immunoprecipitates.

AIMed.d141.s1192.sentence: PROTEIN0 is a potent, tight-binding inhibitor of Cdks and can inhibit the phosphorylation of PROTEIN1 by PROTEIN2-PROTEIN3, PROTEIN4-PROTEIN5, PROTEIN6-PROTEIN7, and PROTEIN8-PROTEIN9 complexes.
AIMed.d141.s1192.orig_sentence: p21CIP1 is a potent, tight-binding inhibitor of Cdks and can inhibit the phosphorylation of Rb by cyclin A-Cdk2, cyclin E-Cdk2, cyclin D1-Cdk4, and cyclin D2-Cdk4 complexes.

AIMed.d141.s1193.sentence: Cotransfection experiments indicate that PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 function in a mutually antagonistic manner to control cell cycle progression.
AIMed.d141.s1193.orig_sentence: Cotransfection experiments indicate that CIP1 and SV40 T antigen function in a mutually antagonistic manner to control cell cycle progression.

AIMed.d142.s1194.sentence: Evidence for physical interaction between the zinc-finger transcription factors PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d142.s1194.orig_sentence: Evidence for physical interaction between the zinc-finger transcription factors YY1 and Sp1.

AIMed.d142.s1195.sentence: Two promoter elements are important for basal-level transcription, the TATA motif typically located 30 nucleotides upstream of the transcription initiation site and the initiator (Inr) element encompassing the start site.
AIMed.d142.s1195.orig_sentence: Two promoter elements are important for basal-level transcription, the TATA motif typically located 30 nucleotides upstream of the transcription initiation site and the initiator (Inr) element encompassing the start site.

AIMed.d142.s1196.sentence: The mechanism of how Inr elements work is poorly understood, partly because very few proteins that bind to Inr elements have been identified and isolated.
AIMed.d142.s1196.orig_sentence: The mechanism of how Inr elements work is poorly understood, partly because very few proteins that bind to Inr elements have been identified and isolated.

AIMed.d142.s1197.sentence: The recently cloned PROTEIN0 is such an PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d142.s1197.orig_sentence: The recently cloned YY1 is such an Inr-binding protein.

AIMed.d142.s1198.sentence: PROTEIN0 is able to direct transcription upon binding to its recognition sequence in vitro.
AIMed.d142.s1198.orig_sentence: YY1 is able to direct transcription upon binding to its recognition sequence in vitro.

AIMed.d142.s1199.sentence: The ability of PROTEIN0 to initiate transcription is augmented by the presence of a TATA motif or binding sites for transcription factor PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d142.s1199.orig_sentence: The ability of YY1 to initiate transcription is augmented by the presence of a TATA motif or binding sites for transcription factor Sp1.

AIMed.d142.s1200.sentence: To study the mechanism underlying the apparent functional cooperation between PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1, we explored the possibility of protein-protein interactions between these two transcription factors.
AIMed.d142.s1200.orig_sentence: To study the mechanism underlying the apparent functional cooperation between YY1 and Sp1, we explored the possibility of protein-protein interactions between these two transcription factors.

AIMed.d142.s1201.sentence: We found that PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 can form a physical complex.
AIMed.d142.s1201.orig_sentence: We found that YY1 and Sp1 can form a physical complex.

AIMed.d142.s1202.sentence: In addition, we identified domains within PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 that mediate their interactions with each other.
AIMed.d142.s1202.orig_sentence: In addition, we identified domains within YY1 and Sp1 that mediate their interactions with each other.

AIMed.d142.s1203.sentence: The physical interaction between PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 may thus form the basis for the functional interplay observed previously.
AIMed.d142.s1203.orig_sentence: The physical interaction between YY1 and Sp1 may thus form the basis for the functional interplay observed previously.

AIMed.d143.s1204.sentence: Involvement of PROTEIN0 signal transducer PROTEIN1 in PROTEIN2-mediated signal transduction.
AIMed.d143.s1204.orig_sentence: Involvement of IL-6 signal transducer gp130 in IL-11-mediated signal transduction.

AIMed.d143.s1205.sentence: PROTEIN0 is a novel cytokine with a variety of biofunctions which overlap with those of PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d143.s1205.orig_sentence: IL-11 is a novel cytokine with a variety of biofunctions which overlap with those of IL-6.

AIMed.d143.s1206.sentence: We have previously identified PROTEIN0 specific binding protein which is distinct from that of PROTEIN1 in a number of cell lines.
AIMed.d143.s1206.orig_sentence: We have previously identified IL-11 specific binding protein which is distinct from that of IL-6 in a number of cell lines.

AIMed.d143.s1207.sentence: The similarities in biofunctions and differences in ligand binding proteins between PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 prompted us to investigate whether PROTEIN2 shares common signal transduction mechanisms with PROTEIN3.
AIMed.d143.s1207.orig_sentence: The similarities in biofunctions and differences in ligand binding proteins between IL-11 and IL-6 prompted us to investigate whether IL-11 shares common signal transduction mechanisms with IL-6.

AIMed.d143.s1208.sentence: We have examined early signals triggered by PROTEIN0 or PROTEIN1 in a multifactor-dependent human erythroleukemic cell line, TF-1.
AIMed.d143.s1208.orig_sentence: We have examined early signals triggered by IL-11 or IL-6 in a multifactor-dependent human erythroleukemic cell line, TF-1.

AIMed.d143.s1209.sentence: The results showed that PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 can both stimulate cell proliferation, induce similar pattern of protein tyrosine phosphorylation, and activate the same proto-oncogene (PROTEIN2) expression in TF-1 cells.
AIMed.d143.s1209.orig_sentence: The results showed that IL-11 and IL-6 can both stimulate cell proliferation, induce similar pattern of protein tyrosine phosphorylation, and activate the same proto-oncogene (junB) expression in TF-1 cells.

AIMed.d143.s1210.sentence: These findings imply that PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 share similar early signaling events with the possibility of using the same signal transducer, PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d143.s1210.orig_sentence: These findings imply that IL-11 and IL-6 share similar early signaling events with the possibility of using the same signal transducer, gp130.

AIMed.d143.s1211.sentence: We next tested whether PROTEIN0 induced signaling can be inhibited by anti-PROTEIN1 antibodies which blocked PROTEIN2-mediated functions.
AIMed.d143.s1211.orig_sentence: We next tested whether IL-11 induced signaling can be inhibited by anti-gp130 antibodies which blocked IL-6-mediated functions.

AIMed.d143.s1212.sentence: It was observed that anti-PROTEIN0 antibodies abolished cell proliferation, protein tyrosine phosphorylation, and PROTEIN1 gene expression elicited by PROTEIN2 or PROTEIN3 in TF-1 cells.
AIMed.d143.s1212.orig_sentence: It was observed that anti-gp130 antibodies abolished cell proliferation, protein tyrosine phosphorylation, and junB gene expression elicited by IL-11 or IL-6 in TF-1 cells.

AIMed.d143.s1213.sentence: The same antibodies, however, had no effect on granulocyte-macrophage colony stimulating factor or erythropoietin-induced TF-1 cell proliferation.
AIMed.d143.s1213.orig_sentence: The same antibodies, however, had no effect on granulocyte-macrophage colony stimulating factor or erythropoietin-induced TF-1 cell proliferation.

AIMed.d143.s1214.sentence: Finally, anti-PROTEIN0 antibody inhibited the ability of PROTEIN1, but not PROTEIN2, to transduce early signals in TF-1 cells.
AIMed.d143.s1214.orig_sentence: Finally, anti-IL-6R antibody inhibited the ability of IL-6, but not IL-11, to transduce early signals in TF-1 cells.

AIMed.d143.s1215.sentence: These results demonstrate that PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 utilize different ligand binding proteins, but share common signal transducer, PROTEIN2, in TF-1 cells.
AIMed.d143.s1215.orig_sentence: These results demonstrate that IL-11 and IL-6 utilize different ligand binding proteins, but share common signal transducer, gp130, in TF-1 cells.

AIMed.d144.s1216.sentence: The PROTEIN0 associates with the PROTEIN1 catalytic subunit.
AIMed.d144.s1216.orig_sentence: The retinoblastoma protein associates with the protein phosphatase type 1 catalytic subunit.

AIMed.d144.s1217.sentence: The PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1) interacts with many cellular proteins in complexes potentially important for its growth-suppressing function.
AIMed.d144.s1217.orig_sentence: The retinoblastoma protein (p110RB) interacts with many cellular proteins in complexes potentially important for its growth-suppressing function.

AIMed.d144.s1218.sentence: We have developed and used an improved version of the yeast two-hybrid system to isolate human cDNAs encoding proteins able to bind PROTEIN0.
AIMed.d144.s1218.orig_sentence: We have developed and used an improved version of the yeast two-hybrid system to isolate human cDNAs encoding proteins able to bind p110RB.

AIMed.d144.s1219.sentence: One clone encodes a novel PROTEIN0 catalytic subunit (PROTEIN1), which differs from the originally defined PROTEIN2 by an amino-terminal 11-amino-acid insert.
AIMed.d144.s1219.orig_sentence: One clone encodes a novel type 1 protein phosphatase catalytic subunit (PP-1 alpha 2), which differs from the originally defined PP-1 alpha by an amino-terminal 11-amino-acid insert.

AIMed.d144.s1220.sentence: In vitro-binding assays demonstrated that PROTEIN0 isoforms preferentially bind the hypophosphorylated form of PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d144.s1220.orig_sentence: In vitro-binding assays demonstrated that PP-1 alpha isoforms preferentially bind the hypophosphorylated form of p110RB.

AIMed.d144.s1221.sentence: Moreover, similar PROTEIN0 sequences are required for binding PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d144.s1221.orig_sentence: Moreover, similar p110RB sequences are required for binding PP-1 alpha 2 and SV40 large T antigen.

AIMed.d144.s1222.sentence: Cell cycle synchrony experiments revealed that this association occurs from mitosis to early G1.
AIMed.d144.s1222.orig_sentence: Cell cycle synchrony experiments revealed that this association occurs from mitosis to early G1.

AIMed.d144.s1223.sentence: The implications of these findings on the regulation of both proteins are discussed.
AIMed.d144.s1223.orig_sentence: The implications of these findings on the regulation of both proteins are discussed.

AIMed.d145.s1224.sentence: Crystal structure of the soluble human 55 kd TNF receptor-human PROTEIN0 complex: implications for TNF receptor activation.
AIMed.d145.s1224.orig_sentence: Crystal structure of the soluble human 55 kd TNF receptor-human TNF beta complex: implications for TNF receptor activation.

AIMed.d145.s1225.orig_sentence: The X-ray crystal structure of the complex of the extracellular domain of the human 55 kd tumor necrosis factor (TNF) receptor with human TNF beta has been determined at 2.85 A resolution.

AIMed.d145.s1226.orig_sentence: The complex has three receptor molecules bound symmetrically to one TNF beta trimer.

AIMed.d145.s1228.sentence: The structure of the complex defines the orientation of the ligand with respect to the cell membrane and provides a model for TNF receptor activation.
AIMed.d145.s1228.orig_sentence: The structure of the complex defines the orientation of the ligand with respect to the cell membrane and provides a model for TNF receptor activation.

AIMed.d145.s1229.orig_sentence: The novel fold of the TNF receptor structure is likely to be representative of the nerve growth factor (NGF)/TNF receptor family as a whole.

AIMed.d146.s1230.orig_sentence: Characterization of a novel high affinity human IL-7 receptor. Expression on T cells and association with IL-7 driven proliferation.

AIMed.d146.s1232.orig_sentence: This responsiveness may occur as a direct result of changes in the structure of the IL-7R during T-cell activation.

AIMed.d146.s1234.sentence: In this study the origin and function of the PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 molecules have been investigated.

AIMed.d146.s1235.sentence: To determine the role of each of these receptors in PROTEIN0 driven proliferation, PROTEIN1 expression and proliferative capacity were monitored during mitogenic stimulation.
AIMed.d146.s1235.orig_sentence: To determine the role of each of these receptors in IL-7 driven proliferation, IL-7R expression and proliferative capacity were monitored during mitogenic stimulation.

AIMed.d146.s1236.sentence: These analyses showed that the ability of PBMC to proliferate to PROTEIN0 correlated with expression of the PROTEIN1 PROTEIN2, and not with expression of the PROTEIN3 PROTEIN4.
AIMed.d146.s1236.orig_sentence: These analyses showed that the ability of PBMC to proliferate to IL-7 correlated with expression of the p76 IL-7R, and not with expression of the p90 IL-7R.

AIMed.d146.s1237.sentence: PROTEIN0-driven proliferation is mediated via high affinity PROTEIN1, and accordingly, Scatchard analysis revealed that, like the PROTEIN2 PROTEIN3, the PROTEIN4 PROTEIN5 bound PROTEIN6 with dual (high; Kd 38 pM and low; Kd 360 pM) affinity.
AIMed.d146.s1237.orig_sentence: IL-7-driven proliferation is mediated via high affinity IL-7R, and accordingly, Scatchard analysis revealed that, like the p90 IL-7R, the p76 IL-7R bound IL-7 with dual (high; Kd 38 pM and low; Kd 360 pM) affinity.

AIMed.d146.s1238.sentence: Deglycosylation studies showed that the PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 PROTEIN2 are not simply differently glycosylated isoforms of a single receptor.
AIMed.d146.s1238.orig_sentence: Deglycosylation studies showed that the p90 and p76 IL-7R are not simply differently glycosylated isoforms of a single receptor.

AIMed.d146.s1239.sentence: In agreement, mAb to the previously cloned PROTEIN0 were found to stain unstimulated T cells that express only the PROTEIN1 PROTEIN2 but not T-cell clones that express predominantly the PROTEIN3 PROTEIN4.
AIMed.d146.s1239.orig_sentence: In agreement, mAb to the previously cloned IL-7R were found to stain unstimulated T cells that express only the p90 IL-7R but not T-cell clones that express predominantly the p76 IL-7R.

AIMed.d146.s1240.sentence: These antibodies also immunoprecipitated the cloned PROTEIN0 as a 90-kDa species from both 125-I-surface-labeled resting and activated T cells, but were unable to precipitate the 76-kDa PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d146.s1240.orig_sentence: These antibodies also immunoprecipitated the cloned IL-7R as a 90-kDa species from both 125-I-surface-labeled resting and activated T cells, but were unable to precipitate the 76-kDa IL-7R.

AIMed.d146.s1241.sentence: In addition, PCR analysis of PROTEIN0-expressing cells could not detect splicing of the extracellular domain of the cloned PROTEIN1, thereby excluding the possibility that the PROTEIN2 PROTEIN3 is a previously undescribed splice variant of the cloned PROTEIN4.
AIMed.d146.s1241.orig_sentence: In addition, PCR analysis of p76-expressing cells could not detect splicing of the extracellular domain of the cloned IL-7R, thereby excluding the possibility that the p76 IL-7R is a previously undescribed splice variant of the cloned IL-7R.

AIMed.d146.s1242.sentence: These data demonstrate that the PROTEIN0 PROTEIN1 is the T-cell homologue of the cloned PROTEIN2, and imply that the PROTEIN3 and PROTEIN4 PROTEIN5 have different extracellular domains.
AIMed.d146.s1242.orig_sentence: These data demonstrate that the p90 IL-7R is the T-cell homologue of the cloned IL-7R, and imply that the p90 and p76 IL-7R have different extracellular domains.

AIMed.d146.s1243.sentence: Taken together these data suggest that the 76-kDa receptor is a novel high affinity PROTEIN0 that may be necessary for PROTEIN1 driven proliferation in human T cells.
AIMed.d146.s1243.orig_sentence: Taken together these data suggest that the 76-kDa receptor is a novel high affinity IL-7R that may be necessary for IL-7 driven proliferation in human T cells.

AIMed.d147.s1244.sentence: Characterization of the PROTEIN0 binding proteins PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d147.s1244.orig_sentence: Characterization of the retinoblastoma binding proteins RBP1 and RBP2.

AIMed.d147.s1245.sentence: The PROTEIN0 gene product, PROTEIN1, regulates cell proliferation by binding to and inhibiting the activity of key growth promoting proteins.
AIMed.d147.s1245.orig_sentence: The retinoblastoma gene product, pRB, regulates cell proliferation by binding to and inhibiting the activity of key growth promoting proteins.

AIMed.d147.s1246.sentence: Several cellular proteins have been shown to bind directly to PROTEIN0 and the genes encoding a number of them have been isolated.
AIMed.d147.s1246.orig_sentence: Several cellular proteins have been shown to bind directly to pRB and the genes encoding a number of them have been isolated.

AIMed.d147.s1247.sentence: The protein product of one of these genes is the transcription factor PROTEIN0.
AIMed.d147.s1247.orig_sentence: The protein product of one of these genes is the transcription factor E2F.

AIMed.d147.s1248.sentence: We have now isolated cDNA clones that contain the full-length coding sequence of two other proteins, PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1, cloned originally by their interaction with PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d147.s1248.orig_sentence: We have now isolated cDNA clones that contain the full-length coding sequence of two other proteins, RBP1 and RBP2, cloned originally by their interaction with pRB.

AIMed.d147.s1249.sentence: The products of the PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 genes are ubiquitously expressed, large (200 kDa for PROTEIN2 and 195 kDa for PROTEIN3) nuclear phosphoproteins with structural motifs that suggest a role in transcriptional regulation.
AIMed.d147.s1249.orig_sentence: The products of the RBP1 and RBP2 genes are ubiquitously expressed, large (200 kDa for RBP1 and 195 kDa for RBP2) nuclear phosphoproteins with structural motifs that suggest a role in transcriptional regulation.

AIMed.d147.s1250.sentence: In addition we have been able to identify complexes of PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 in vivo that are dissociated in the presence of purified human papillomavirus PROTEIN2 protein.
AIMed.d147.s1250.orig_sentence: In addition we have been able to identify complexes of pRB and RBP1 in vivo that are dissociated in the presence of purified human papillomavirus E7 protein.

AIMed.d148.s1251.sentence: Two potentially oncogenic cyclins, PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1, share common properties of subunit configuration, tyrosine phosphorylation and physical association with the PROTEIN2 protein
AIMed.d148.s1251.orig_sentence: Two potentially oncogenic cyclins, cyclin A and cyclin D1, share common properties of subunit configuration, tyrosine phosphorylation and physical association with the Rb protein

AIMed.d148.s1252.sentence: .Originally identified as a 'mitotic cyclin', PROTEIN0 exhibits properties of growth factor sensitivity, susceptibility to viral subversion and association with a tumor-suppressor protein, properties which are indicative of an PROTEIN1 (PROTEIN2) as well as a candidate proto-oncogene.
AIMed.d148.s1252.orig_sentence: .Originally identified as a 'mitotic cyclin', cyclin A exhibits properties of growth factor sensitivity, susceptibility to viral subversion and association with a tumor-suppressor protein, properties which are indicative of an S-phase-promoting factor (SPF) as well as a candidate proto-oncogene.

AIMed.d148.s1253.sentence: Other recent studies have identified human PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1) as a putative G1 cyclin and candidate proto-oncogene.
AIMed.d148.s1253.orig_sentence: Other recent studies have identified human cyclin D1 (PRAD1) as a putative G1 cyclin and candidate proto-oncogene.

AIMed.d148.s1254.sentence: However, the specific enzymatic activities and, hence, the precise biochemical mechanisms through which cyclins function to govern cell cycle progression remain unresolved.
AIMed.d148.s1254.orig_sentence: However, the specific enzymatic activities and, hence, the precise biochemical mechanisms through which cyclins function to govern cell cycle progression remain unresolved.

AIMed.d148.s1255.sentence: In the present study we have investigated the coordinate interactions between these two potentially oncogenic cyclins, cyclin-dependent protein kinase subunits (cdks) and the PROTEIN0 tumor-suppressor protein.
AIMed.d148.s1255.orig_sentence: In the present study we have investigated the coordinate interactions between these two potentially oncogenic cyclins, cyclin-dependent protein kinase subunits (cdks) and the Rb tumor-suppressor protein.

AIMed.d148.s1256.sentence: The distribution of PROTEIN0 isoforms was modulated by serum factors in primary fetal rat lung epithelial cells.
AIMed.d148.s1256.orig_sentence: The distribution of cyclin D isoforms was modulated by serum factors in primary fetal rat lung epithelial cells.

AIMed.d148.s1257.sentence: Moreover, PROTEIN0 was found to be phosphorylated on tyrosine residues in vivo and, like PROTEIN1, was readily phosphorylated by PROTEIN2 in vitro.
AIMed.d148.s1257.orig_sentence: Moreover, cyclin D1 was found to be phosphorylated on tyrosine residues in vivo and, like cyclin A, was readily phosphorylated by pp60c-src in vitro.

AIMed.d148.s1258.sentence: In synchronized human osteosarcoma cells, PROTEIN0 is induced in early G1 and becomes associated with PROTEIN1, a Cdk-binding subunit.
AIMed.d148.s1258.orig_sentence: In synchronized human osteosarcoma cells, cyclin D1 is induced in early G1 and becomes associated with p9Ckshs1, a Cdk-binding subunit.

AIMed.d148.s1259.sentence: Immunoprecipitation experiments with human osteosarcoma cells and Ewing's sarcoma cells demonstrated that PROTEIN0 is associated with both PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2, and that PROTEIN3 immune complexes exhibit appreciable histone H1 kinase activity.
AIMed.d148.s1259.orig_sentence: Immunoprecipitation experiments with human osteosarcoma cells and Ewing's sarcoma cells demonstrated that cyclin D1 is associated with both p34cdc2 and p33cdk2, and that cyclin D1 immune complexes exhibit appreciable histone H1 kinase activity.

AIMed.d148.s1260.sentence: Immobilized, recombinant cyclins A and D1 were found to associate with cellular proteins in complexes that contain the PROTEIN0 protein.
AIMed.d148.s1260.orig_sentence: Immobilized, recombinant cyclins A and D1 were found to associate with cellular proteins in complexes that contain the p105Rb protein.

AIMed.d148.s1261.sentence: This study identifies several common aspects of cyclin biochemistry, including tyrosine phosphorylation and the potential to interact directly or indirectly with the PROTEIN0 protein, that may ultimately relate membrane-mediated signaling events to the regulation of gene expression.
AIMed.d148.s1261.orig_sentence: This study identifies several common aspects of cyclin biochemistry, including tyrosine phosphorylation and the potential to interact directly or indirectly with the Rb protein, that may ultimately relate membrane-mediated signaling events to the regulation of gene expression.

AIMed.d150.s1273.sentence: Regulation of the PROTEIN0-related transcription factor PROTEIN1 by binding to the PROTEIN2 protein.
AIMed.d150.s1273.orig_sentence: Regulation of the Ets-related transcription factor Elf-1 by binding to the retinoblastoma protein.

AIMed.d150.s1274.sentence: The PROTEIN0 gene product (PROTEIN1) is a nuclear phosphoprotein that regulates cell cycle progression.
AIMed.d150.s1274.orig_sentence: The retinoblastoma gene product (Rb) is a nuclear phosphoprotein that regulates cell cycle progression.

AIMed.d150.s1275.sentence: PROTEIN0 is a lymphoid-specific PROTEIN1 transcription factor that regulates inducible gene expression during T cell activation.
AIMed.d150.s1275.orig_sentence: Elf-1 is a lymphoid-specific Ets transcription factor that regulates inducible gene expression during T cell activation.

AIMed.d150.s1276.sentence: In this report, it is demonstrated that PROTEIN0 contains a sequence motif that is highly related to the PROTEIN1 binding sites of several viral oncoproteins and binds to the pocket region of PROTEIN2 both in vitro and in vivo.
AIMed.d150.s1276.orig_sentence: In this report, it is demonstrated that Elf-1 contains a sequence motif that is highly related to the Rb binding sites of several viral oncoproteins and binds to the pocket region of Rb both in vitro and in vivo.

AIMed.d150.s1277.sentence: PROTEIN0 binds exclusively to the underphosphorylated form of PROTEIN1 and fails to bind to PROTEIN2 mutants derived from patients with retinoblastoma.
AIMed.d150.s1277.orig_sentence: Elf-1 binds exclusively to the underphosphorylated form of Rb and fails to bind to Rb mutants derived from patients with retinoblastoma.

AIMed.d150.s1278.sentence: Co-immunoprecipitation experiments demonstrated an association between PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 in resting normal human T cells.
AIMed.d150.s1278.orig_sentence: Co-immunoprecipitation experiments demonstrated an association between Elf-1 and Rb in resting normal human T cells.

AIMed.d150.s1279.sentence: After T cell activation, the phosphorylation of PROTEIN0 results in the release of PROTEIN1, which is correlated temporally with the activation of PROTEIN2-mediated transcription.
AIMed.d150.s1279.orig_sentence: After T cell activation, the phosphorylation of Rb results in the release of Elf-1, which is correlated temporally with the activation of Elf-1-mediated transcription.

AIMed.d150.s1280.sentence: Overexpression of a phosphorylation-defective form of PROTEIN0 inhibited PROTEIN1-dependent transcription during T cell activation.
AIMed.d150.s1280.orig_sentence: Overexpression of a phosphorylation-defective form of Rb inhibited Elf-1-dependent transcription during T cell activation.

AIMed.d150.s1281.sentence: These results demonstrate that PROTEIN0 interacts specifically with a lineage-restricted PROTEIN1 transcription factor.
AIMed.d150.s1281.orig_sentence: These results demonstrate that Rb interacts specifically with a lineage-restricted Ets transcription factor.

AIMed.d150.s1282.sentence: This regulated interaction may be important for the coordination of lineage-specific effector functions such as lymphokine production with cell cycle progression in activated T cells.
AIMed.d150.s1282.orig_sentence: This regulated interaction may be important for the coordination of lineage-specific effector functions such as lymphokine production with cell cycle progression in activated T cells.

AIMed.d151.s1283.sentence: Cloning of two proximal sequence element-binding transcription factor subunits (gamma and delta) that are required for transcription of small nuclear RNA genes by RNA polymerases II and III and interact with the PROTEIN0.
AIMed.d151.s1283.orig_sentence: Cloning of two proximal sequence element-binding transcription factor subunits (gamma and delta) that are required for transcription of small nuclear RNA genes by RNA polymerases II and III and interact with the TATA-binding protein.

AIMed.d151.s1284.sentence: The PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1) specifically recognizes the PSEs of both RNA polymerase II- and RNA polymerase III-transcribed small nuclear RNA (snRNA) genes.
AIMed.d151.s1284.orig_sentence: The proximal sequence element (PSE)-binding transcription factor (PTF) specifically recognizes the PSEs of both RNA polymerase II- and RNA polymerase III-transcribed small nuclear RNA (snRNA) genes.

AIMed.d151.s1285.sentence: We previously have shown that PROTEIN0 purified from human HeLa cells is a multisubunit complex of four polypeptides designated PROTEIN1 PROTEIN2, -beta, -gamma, and -delta.
AIMed.d151.s1285.orig_sentence: We previously have shown that PTF purified from human HeLa cells is a multisubunit complex of four polypeptides designated PTF alpha, -beta, -gamma, and -delta.

AIMed.d151.s1286.sentence: We now report the isolation and expression of cDNAs encoding PROTEIN0 gamma and PROTEIN1 delta, as well as functional studies with cognate antibodies that recognize the native PROTEIN2 complex in HeLa extracts.
AIMed.d151.s1286.orig_sentence: We now report the isolation and expression of cDNAs encoding PTF gamma and PTF delta, as well as functional studies with cognate antibodies that recognize the native PTF complex in HeLa extracts.

AIMed.d151.s1287.sentence: Immunoprecipitation studies confirm that the four PROTEIN0 subunits originally found to copurify during conventional chromatography indeed form a tightly associated complex; they further show that the PROTEIN1 so defined, including the gamma and delta subunits specifically, is essential for transcription of both class II and class III snRNA genes.
AIMed.d151.s1287.orig_sentence: Immunoprecipitation studies confirm that the four PTF subunits originally found to copurify during conventional chromatography indeed form a tightly associated complex; they further show that the PTF so defined, including the gamma and delta subunits specifically, is essential for transcription of both class II and class III snRNA genes.

AIMed.d151.s1288.sentence: Immunoprecipitation assays also show a weak substoichiometric association of the PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1) with PROTEIN2, consistent with the previous report of a PROTEIN3-related complex (PROTEIN4) containing substoichiometric levels of PROTEIN5 and a component (PROTEIN6) identical in sequence to the PROTEIN7 gamma reported here.
AIMed.d151.s1288.orig_sentence: Immunoprecipitation assays also show a weak substoichiometric association of the TATA-binding protein (TBP) with PTF, consistent with the previous report of a PTF-related complex (SNAPc) containing substoichiometric levels of TBP and a component (SNAPc43) identical in sequence to the PTF gamma reported here.

AIMed.d151.s1289.sentence: Glutathione S-transferase pulldown assays further indicate relatively strong direct interactions of both recombinant PROTEIN0 gamma and PROTEIN1 delta with PROTEIN2, consistent either with the natural association of PROTEIN3 with PROTEIN4 in a semistable PROTEIN5-PROTEIN6-associated factor complex or with possible functional interactions between PSE-bound PROTEIN7 and TATA-bound PROTEIN8 during promoter activation.
AIMed.d151.s1289.orig_sentence: Glutathione S-transferase pulldown assays further indicate relatively strong direct interactions of both recombinant PTF gamma and PTF delta with TBP, consistent either with the natural association of TBP with PTF in a semistable TBP-TBP-associated factor complex or with possible functional interactions between PSE-bound PTF and TATA-bound TBP during promoter activation.

AIMed.d151.s1290.sentence: In addition, we show that in extracts depleted of PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1-associated factors, transcription from the U1 promoter is restored by recombinant PROTEIN2 but not by PROTEIN3 or PROTEIN4, indicating that transcription of class II snRNA genes requires a PROTEIN5 complex different from the one used for mRNA-encoding genes.
AIMed.d151.s1290.orig_sentence: In addition, we show that in extracts depleted of TBP and TBP-associated factors, transcription from the U1 promoter is restored by recombinant TBP but not by TFIID or TFIIIB, indicating that transcription of class II snRNA genes requires a TBP complex different from the one used for mRNA-encoding genes.

AIMed.d152.s1291.sentence: PROTEIN0-PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2-PROTEIN3 interactions define two distinct PROTEIN4 signal transduction pathways.
AIMed.d152.s1291.orig_sentence: TRADD-TRAF2 and TRADD-FADD interactions define two distinct TNF receptor 1 signal transduction pathways.

AIMed.d152.s1292.sentence: Tumor necrosis factor (TNF) can induce apoptosis and activate PROTEIN0 through signaling cascades emanating from PROTEIN1 (PROTEIN2).
AIMed.d152.s1292.orig_sentence: Tumor necrosis factor (TNF) can induce apoptosis and activate NF-kappa B through signaling cascades emanating from TNF receptor 1 (TNFR1).

AIMed.d152.s1293.sentence: PROTEIN0 is a PROTEIN1-associated signal transducer that is involved in activating both pathways.
AIMed.d152.s1293.orig_sentence: TRADD is a TNFR1-associated signal transducer that is involved in activating both pathways.

AIMed.d152.s1294.sentence: Here we show that PROTEIN0 directly interacts with PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2, signal transducers that activate PROTEIN3 and induce apoptosis, respectively.
AIMed.d152.s1294.orig_sentence: Here we show that TRADD directly interacts with TRAF2 and FADD, signal transducers that activate NF-kappa B and induce apoptosis, respectively.

AIMed.d152.s1295.sentence: A PROTEIN0 mutant lacking its N-terminal RING finger domain is a dominant-negative inhibitor of TNF-mediated PROTEIN1 activation, but does not affect TNF-induced apoptosis.
AIMed.d152.s1295.orig_sentence: A TRAF2 mutant lacking its N-terminal RING finger domain is a dominant-negative inhibitor of TNF-mediated NF-kappa B activation, but does not affect TNF-induced apoptosis.

AIMed.d152.s1296.sentence: Conversely, a PROTEIN0 mutant lacking its N-terminal 79 amino acids is a dominant-negative inhibitor of TNF-induced apoptosis, but does not inhibit PROTEIN1 activation.
AIMed.d152.s1296.orig_sentence: Conversely, a FADD mutant lacking its N-terminal 79 amino acids is a dominant-negative inhibitor of TNF-induced apoptosis, but does not inhibit NF-kappa B activation.

AIMed.d152.s1297.sentence: Thus, these two PROTEIN0-PROTEIN1 signaling cascades appear to bifurcate at PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d152.s1297.orig_sentence: Thus, these two TNFR1-TRADD signaling cascades appear to bifurcate at TRADD.

AIMed.d153.s1298.sentence: Characterization of PROTEIN0 binding to human PROTEIN1 on T cells and its biologic role in immune response.
AIMed.d153.s1298.orig_sentence: Characterization of adenosine deaminase binding to human CD26 on T cells and its biologic role in immune response.

AIMed.d153.s1299.sentence: PROTEIN0, a T cell activation Ag, also known as PROTEIN1,is directly associated with PROTEIN2 (PROTEIN3) on the surface of T cells and T cell lines.
AIMed.d153.s1299.orig_sentence: CD26, a T cell activation Ag, also known as dipeptidyl peptidase IV,is directly associated with adenosine deaminase (ADA) on the surface of T cells and T cell lines.

AIMed.d153.s1300.sentence: In the present study, we examined both the binding of PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 and the functional consequences of this interaction.
AIMed.d153.s1300.orig_sentence: In the present study, we examined both the binding of ADA and CD26 and the functional consequences of this interaction.

AIMed.d153.s1301.sentence: We found that PROTEIN0 was associated with PROTEIN1 on T cell lines lacking either PROTEIN2 or PROTEIN3 enzymatic activity, indicating that the association between PROTEIN4 and PROTEIN5 did not require enzymatic activity.
AIMed.d153.s1301.orig_sentence: We found that ADA was associated with CD26 on T cell lines lacking either ADA or dipeptidyl peptidase IV enzymatic activity, indicating that the association between dipeptidyl peptidase IV and ADA did not require enzymatic activity.

AIMed.d153.s1302.sentence: Moreover, using immunoelectron microscopy, we demonstrated that PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 co-localized on the cell surface, but not inside cells, suggesting that PROTEIN2 did not transport PROTEIN3 to the surface.
AIMed.d153.s1302.orig_sentence: Moreover, using immunoelectron microscopy, we demonstrated that CD26 and ADA co-localized on the cell surface, but not inside cells, suggesting that CD26 did not transport ADA to the surface.

AIMed.d153.s1303.sentence: In keeping with this observation, we showed that human PROTEIN0-transfected murine pre-B cell lines lacking human PROTEIN1 acquired PROTEIN2 from an extracellular source.
AIMed.d153.s1303.orig_sentence: In keeping with this observation, we showed that human CD26-transfected murine pre-B cell lines lacking human ADA acquired ADA from an extracellular source.

AIMed.d153.s1304.sentence: More importantly, adenosine in the absence of cell surface PROTEIN0 inhibited T cell proliferation and PROTEIN1 production induced by various stimuli.
AIMed.d153.s1304.orig_sentence: More importantly, adenosine in the absence of cell surface ADA inhibited T cell proliferation and IL-2 production induced by various stimuli.

AIMed.d153.s1305.sentence: On the other hand, cells expressing PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 on the surface were much more resistant to the inhibitory effect of adenosine.
AIMed.d153.s1305.orig_sentence: On the other hand, cells expressing ADA and CD26 on the surface were much more resistant to the inhibitory effect of adenosine.

AIMed.d153.s1306.sentence: These data suggest that PROTEIN0 on the cell surface is involved in an important immunoregulatory mechanism by which released PROTEIN1 binds to cell surface PROTEIN2, and this complex is capable of reducing the local concentration of adenosine.
AIMed.d153.s1306.orig_sentence: These data suggest that ADA on the cell surface is involved in an important immunoregulatory mechanism by which released ADA binds to cell surface CD26, and this complex is capable of reducing the local concentration of adenosine.

AIMed.d154.s1307.sentence: The three human syntrophin genes are expressed in diverse tissues, have distinct chromosomal locations, and each bind to PROTEIN0 and its relatives.
AIMed.d154.s1307.orig_sentence: The three human syntrophin genes are expressed in diverse tissues, have distinct chromosomal locations, and each bind to dystrophin and its relatives.

AIMed.d154.s1308.sentence: The syntrophins are a biochemically heterogeneous group of 58-kDa intracellular membrane-associated PROTEIN0-binding proteins.
AIMed.d154.s1308.orig_sentence: The syntrophins are a biochemically heterogeneous group of 58-kDa intracellular membrane-associated dystrophin-binding proteins.

AIMed.d154.s1309.sentence: We have cloned and characterized human PROTEIN0 and a second isoform of human PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d154.s1309.orig_sentence: We have cloned and characterized human acidic (alpha 1-) syntrophin and a second isoform of human basic (beta 2-) syntrophin.

AIMed.d154.s1310.sentence: Comparison of the deduced amino acid structure of the three human isoforms of syntrophin (together with the previously reported human PROTEIN0) demonstrates their overall similarity.
AIMed.d154.s1310.orig_sentence: Comparison of the deduced amino acid structure of the three human isoforms of syntrophin (together with the previously reported human beta 1-syntrophin) demonstrates their overall similarity.

AIMed.d154.s1311.sentence: The deduced amino acid sequences of human alpha 1- and PROTEIN0 are nearly identical to their homologues in mouse, suggesting a strong functional conservation among the individual isoforms, Much like PROTEIN1, human PROTEIN2 has multiple transcript classes and is expressed widely, although in a distinct pattern of relative abundance.
AIMed.d154.s1311.orig_sentence: The deduced amino acid sequences of human alpha 1- and beta 2-syntrophin are nearly identical to their homologues in mouse, suggesting a strong functional conservation among the individual isoforms, Much like beta 1-syntrophin, human beta 2-syntrophin has multiple transcript classes and is expressed widely, although in a distinct pattern of relative abundance.

AIMed.d154.s1312.sentence: In contrast, human PROTEIN0 is most abundant in heart and skeletal muscle, and less so in other tissues.
AIMed.d154.s1312.orig_sentence: In contrast, human alpha 1-syntrophin is most abundant in heart and skeletal muscle, and less so in other tissues.

AIMed.d154.s1313.sentence: Somatic cell hybrids and fluorescent in situ hybridization were both used to determine their chromosomal locations: PROTEIN0 to chromosome 16q22-23 and PROTEIN1 to chromosome 20q11.2.
AIMed.d154.s1313.orig_sentence: Somatic cell hybrids and fluorescent in situ hybridization were both used to determine their chromosomal locations: beta 2-syntrophin to chromosome 16q22-23 and alpha 1-syntrophin to chromosome 20q11.2.

AIMed.d154.s1314.sentence: Finally, we used in vitro translated proteins in an immunoprecipitation assay to show that, like PROTEIN0, both beta 2- and PROTEIN1 interact with peptides encoding the syntrophin-binding region of PROTEIN2, PROTEIN3/PROTEIN4 PROTEIN5, and the PROTEIN6.
AIMed.d154.s1314.orig_sentence: Finally, we used in vitro translated proteins in an immunoprecipitation assay to show that, like beta 1-syntrophin, both beta 2- and alpha 1-syntrophin interact with peptides encoding the syntrophin-binding region of dystrophin, utrophin/dystrophin related protein, and the Torpedo 87K protein.

AIMed.d157.s1326.sentence: Coordination of three signaling enzymes by PROTEIN0, a mammalian scaffold protein.
AIMed.d157.s1326.orig_sentence: Coordination of three signaling enzymes by AKAP79, a mammalian scaffold protein.

AIMed.d157.s1327.sentence: Multivalent binding proteins, such as the yeast scaffold protein PROTEIN0, coordinate the location of kinases by serving as platforms for the assembly of signaling units.
AIMed.d157.s1327.orig_sentence: Multivalent binding proteins, such as the yeast scaffold protein Sterile-5, coordinate the location of kinases by serving as platforms for the assembly of signaling units.

AIMed.d157.s1328.sentence: Similarly, in mammalian cells the cyclic adenosine 3',5'-monophosphate-dependent protein kinase (PROTEIN0) and PROTEIN1 [PROTEIN2 (PROTEIN3)] are complexed by an PROTEIN4, PROTEIN5.
AIMed.d157.s1328.orig_sentence: Similarly, in mammalian cells the cyclic adenosine 3',5'-monophosphate-dependent protein kinase (PKA) and phosphatase 2B [calcineurin (CaN)] are complexed by an A kinase anchoring protein, AKAP79.

AIMed.d157.s1329.sentence: Deletion analysis and binding studies demonstrate that a third enzyme, PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1), binds PROTEIN2 at a site distinct from those bound by PROTEIN3 or PROTEIN4.
AIMed.d157.s1329.orig_sentence: Deletion analysis and binding studies demonstrate that a third enzyme, protein kinase C (PKC), binds AKAP79 at a site distinct from those bound by PKA or CaN.

AIMed.d157.s1330.sentence: The subcellular distributions of PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 were similar in neurons.
AIMed.d157.s1330.orig_sentence: The subcellular distributions of PKC and AKAP79 were similar in neurons.

AIMed.d157.s1331.sentence: Thus, PROTEIN0 appears to function as a scaffold protein for three multifunctional enzymes.
AIMed.d157.s1331.orig_sentence: Thus, AKAP79 appears to function as a scaffold protein for three multifunctional enzymes.

AIMed.d158.s1332.sentence: TNF-dependent recruitment of the protein kinase PROTEIN0 to the PROTEIN1 signaling complex.
AIMed.d158.s1332.orig_sentence: TNF-dependent recruitment of the protein kinase RIP to the TNF receptor-1 signaling complex.

AIMed.d158.s1333.sentence: The death domain of PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1) triggers distinct signaling pathways leading to apoptosis and PROTEIN2 activation through its interaction with the death domain protein PROTEIN3.
AIMed.d158.s1333.orig_sentence: The death domain of tumor necrosis factor (TNF) receptor-1 (TNFR1) triggers distinct signaling pathways leading to apoptosis and NF-kappa B activation through its interaction with the death domain protein TRADD.

AIMed.d158.s1334.sentence: Here, we show that PROTEIN0 interacts strongly with PROTEIN1, another death domain protein that was shown previously to associate with PROTEIN2 antigen.
AIMed.d158.s1334.orig_sentence: Here, we show that TRADD interacts strongly with RIP, another death domain protein that was shown previously to associate with Fas antigen.

AIMed.d158.s1335.sentence: We also show that PROTEIN0 is a serine-threonine kinase that is recruited by PROTEIN1 to PROTEIN2 in a TNF-dependent process.
AIMed.d158.s1335.orig_sentence: We also show that RIP is a serine-threonine kinase that is recruited by TRADD to TNFR1 in a TNF-dependent process.

AIMed.d158.s1336.sentence: Overexpression of the intact PROTEIN0 protein induces both PROTEIN1 activation and apoptosis.
AIMed.d158.s1336.orig_sentence: Overexpression of the intact RIP protein induces both NF-kappa B activation and apoptosis.

AIMed.d158.s1337.sentence: However, expression of the death domain of PROTEIN0 Induces apoptosis, but potently inhibits PROTEIN1 activation by TNF.
AIMed.d158.s1337.orig_sentence: However, expression of the death domain of RIP Induces apoptosis, but potently inhibits NF-kappa B activation by TNF.

AIMed.d158.s1338.sentence: These results suggest that distinct domains of PROTEIN0 participate in the TNF signaling cascades leading to apoptosis and PROTEIN1 activation.
AIMed.d158.s1338.orig_sentence: These results suggest that distinct domains of RIP participate in the TNF signaling cascades leading to apoptosis and NF-kappa B activation.

AIMed.d159.s1339.sentence: Characterization of the PROTEIN0-syntrophin interaction using the two-hybrid system in yeast.
AIMed.d159.s1339.orig_sentence: Characterization of the dystrophin-syntrophin interaction using the two-hybrid system in yeast.

AIMed.d159.s1340.sentence: The carboxy-terminal region of PROTEIN0 has previously been shown to interact directly with PROTEIN1, a cytoplasmic component of the PROTEIN2-glycoprotein complex, by in vitro biochemical studies such as overlay assay or immunoprecipitation.
AIMed.d159.s1340.orig_sentence: The carboxy-terminal region of dystrophin has previously been shown to interact directly with alpha1 syntrophin, a cytoplasmic component of the dystrophin-glycoprotein complex, by in vitro biochemical studies such as overlay assay or immunoprecipitation.

AIMed.d159.s1341.sentence: Using the two-hybrid system, we have isolated from a human heart cDNA library the entire coding sequence of human PROTEIN0, therefore confirming for the first time this interaction via an in vivo approach.
AIMed.d159.s1341.orig_sentence: Using the two-hybrid system, we have isolated from a human heart cDNA library the entire coding sequence of human alpha1 syntrophin, therefore confirming for the first time this interaction via an in vivo approach.

AIMed.d159.s1342.sentence: In addition, we have reduced the interaction domain to the distal half of PROTEIN0.
AIMed.d159.s1342.orig_sentence: In addition, we have reduced the interaction domain to the distal half of alpha1 syntrophin.

AIMed.d160.s1343.sentence: Identification of vascular endothelial growth factor determinants for binding PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 receptors. Generation of receptor-selective PROTEIN2 variants by site-directed mutagenesis.
AIMed.d160.s1343.orig_sentence: Identification of vascular endothelial growth factor determinants for binding KDR and FLT-1 receptors. Generation of receptor-selective VEGF variants by site-directed mutagenesis.

AIMed.d160.s1344.sentence: PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1) expression in various cell types is induced by hypoxia and other stimuli.
AIMed.d160.s1344.orig_sentence: Vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) expression in various cell types is induced by hypoxia and other stimuli.

AIMed.d160.s1345.sentence: PROTEIN0 mediates endothelial cell proliferation, angiogenesis, vascular growth, and vascular permeability via the endothelial cell receptors, PROTEIN1 (PROTEIN2)/PROTEIN3 (PROTEIN4) and PROTEIN5.
AIMed.d160.s1345.orig_sentence: VEGF mediates endothelial cell proliferation, angiogenesis, vascular growth, and vascular permeability via the endothelial cell receptors, kinase insert domain-containing receptor (KDR)/fetal liver kinase 1 (Flk-1) and FLT-1.

AIMed.d160.s1346.sentence: Alanine-scanning mutagenesis was used to identify a positively charged surface in PROTEIN0 that mediates binding to PROTEIN1/PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d160.s1346.orig_sentence: Alanine-scanning mutagenesis was used to identify a positively charged surface in VEGF that mediates binding to KDR/Flk-1.

AIMed.d160.s1347.sentence: Arg82, Lys84 and His86, located in a hairpin loop, were found to be critical for binding PROTEIN0/PROTEIN1, while negatively charged residues, Asp63, Glu64, and Glu67, were associated with PROTEIN2 binding.
AIMed.d160.s1347.orig_sentence: Arg82, Lys84 and His86, located in a hairpin loop, were found to be critical for binding KDR/Flk-1, while negatively charged residues, Asp63, Glu64, and Glu67, were associated with FLT-1 binding.

AIMed.d160.s1348.sentence: A PROTEIN0 model based on PROTEIN1 indicated these positively and negatively charged regions are distal in the monomer but are spatially close in the dimer.
AIMed.d160.s1348.orig_sentence: A VEGF model based on PDGFb indicated these positively and negatively charged regions are distal in the monomer but are spatially close in the dimer.

AIMed.d160.s1349.sentence: Mutations within the PROTEIN0 site had minimal effect on PROTEIN1 binding, and mutants deficient in PROTEIN2 binding did not affect PROTEIN3 binding.
AIMed.d160.s1349.orig_sentence: Mutations within the KDR site had minimal effect on FLT-1 binding, and mutants deficient in FLT-1 binding did not affect KDR binding.

AIMed.d160.s1350.sentence: Endothelial cell mitogenesis was abolished in mutants lacking PROTEIN0 affinity; however, PROTEIN1 deficient mutants induced normal proliferation.
AIMed.d160.s1350.orig_sentence: Endothelial cell mitogenesis was abolished in mutants lacking KDR affinity; however, FLT-1 deficient mutants induced normal proliferation.

AIMed.d160.s1351.sentence: These results suggest dual sets of determinants in the PROTEIN0 dimer that cross-link cell surface receptors, triggering endothelial cell growth and angiogenesis.
AIMed.d160.s1351.orig_sentence: These results suggest dual sets of determinants in the VEGF dimer that cross-link cell surface receptors, triggering endothelial cell growth and angiogenesis.

AIMed.d160.s1352.sentence: Furthermore, this mutational analysis implicates PROTEIN0, but not PROTEIN1, in PROTEIN2 induction of endothelial cell proliferation.
AIMed.d160.s1352.orig_sentence: Furthermore, this mutational analysis implicates KDR, but not FLT-1, in VEGF induction of endothelial cell proliferation.

AIMed.d161.s1353.sentence: Use of the two hybrid system to detect the association of the protein-tyrosine-phosphatase, PROTEIN0, with another SH2-containing protein, PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d161.s1353.orig_sentence: Use of the two hybrid system to detect the association of the protein-tyrosine-phosphatase, SHPTP2, with another SH2-containing protein, Grb7.

AIMed.d161.s1354.sentence: PROTEIN0 is a ubiquitously-expressed SH2-containing tyrosine phosphatase that is tyrosine phosphorylated in response to activation of various receptor and nonreceptor tyrosine kinases.
AIMed.d161.s1354.orig_sentence: SHPTP2 is a ubiquitously-expressed SH2-containing tyrosine phosphatase that is tyrosine phosphorylated in response to activation of various receptor and nonreceptor tyrosine kinases.

AIMed.d161.s1355.sentence: PROTEIN0 associates with the PROTEIN1 PROTEIN2 PROTEIN3 after ligand stimulation, and binding of PROTEIN4 to this receptor promotes tyrosine phosphorylation of PROTEIN5.
AIMed.d161.s1355.orig_sentence: SHPTP2 associates with the platelet-derived growth factor (PDGF) receptor after ligand stimulation, and binding of SHPTP2 to this receptor promotes tyrosine phosphorylation of SHPTP2.

AIMed.d161.s1356.sentence: The yeast two-hybrid system was modified to identify partners of tyrosine-phosphorylated proteins.
AIMed.d161.s1356.orig_sentence: The yeast two-hybrid system was modified to identify partners of tyrosine-phosphorylated proteins.

AIMed.d161.s1357.sentence: Using PROTEIN0 as bait and supplying an exogenous tyrosine kinase gene to the yeast cells, we have found that PROTEIN1 interacts with another signaling protein, PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d161.s1357.orig_sentence: Using SHPTP2 as bait and supplying an exogenous tyrosine kinase gene to the yeast cells, we have found that SHPTP2 interacts with another signaling protein, Grb7.

AIMed.d161.s1358.sentence: We have localized the region of interaction to tyrosine 580 in the carboxyl end of PROTEIN0 and to the SH2 domain in the carboxy-terminus of PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d161.s1358.orig_sentence: We have localized the region of interaction to tyrosine 580 in the carboxyl end of SHPTP2 and to the SH2 domain in the carboxy-terminus of Grb7.

AIMed.d161.s1359.sentence: We demonstrate that PROTEIN0 binds to PROTEIN1 in vitro under conditions where the latter is tyrosine-phosphorylated.
AIMed.d161.s1359.orig_sentence: We demonstrate that Grb7 binds to SHPTP2 in vitro under conditions where the latter is tyrosine-phosphorylated.

AIMed.d161.s1360.sentence: These experiments show that this modified two hybrid technique may be useful for the identification of proteins involved in tyrosine kinase signal transduction cascades.
AIMed.d161.s1360.orig_sentence: These experiments show that this modified two hybrid technique may be useful for the identification of proteins involved in tyrosine kinase signal transduction cascades.

AIMed.d162.s1361.sentence: Modulation of the transcriptional activity of thyroid hormone receptors by the tumor suppressor PROTEIN0.
AIMed.d162.s1361.orig_sentence: Modulation of the transcriptional activity of thyroid hormone receptors by the tumor suppressor p53.

AIMed.d162.s1362.sentence: Thyroid hormone nuclear receptors (TRs) are ligand-dependent transcriptional factors that regulate growth, differentiation, and development.
AIMed.d162.s1362.orig_sentence: Thyroid hormone nuclear receptors (TRs) are ligand-dependent transcriptional factors that regulate growth, differentiation, and development.

AIMed.d162.s1363.sentence: The molecular mechanisms by which TRs mediate these effects are unclear.
AIMed.d162.s1363.orig_sentence: The molecular mechanisms by which TRs mediate these effects are unclear.

AIMed.d162.s1364.sentence: One prevailing hypothesis suggests that TRs may cooperate with other transcriptional factors to mediate their biological effects.
AIMed.d162.s1364.orig_sentence: One prevailing hypothesis suggests that TRs may cooperate with other transcriptional factors to mediate their biological effects.

AIMed.d162.s1365.sentence: In this study, we tested this hypothesis by examining whether the activity of TRs is modulated by the tumor suppressor PROTEIN0.
AIMed.d162.s1365.orig_sentence: In this study, we tested this hypothesis by examining whether the activity of TRs is modulated by the tumor suppressor p53.

AIMed.d162.s1366.sentence: PROTEIN0 is a nuclear protein that regulates gene expression via sequence-specific DNA binding and/or direct protein-protein interaction.
AIMed.d162.s1366.orig_sentence: p53 is a nuclear protein that regulates gene expression via sequence-specific DNA binding and/or direct protein-protein interaction.

AIMed.d162.s1367.sentence: We found that the human PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1) physically interacted with PROTEIN2 via its DNA binding domain.
AIMed.d162.s1367.orig_sentence: We found that the human TR subtype beta 1 (h-TR beta 1) physically interacted with p53 via its DNA binding domain.

AIMed.d162.s1368.sentence: As a result of this physical interaction, binding of PROTEIN0 to its hormone response elements either as homodimer or as a heterodimer with the PROTEIN1 was inhibited by PROTEIN2 in a concentration-dependent manner.
AIMed.d162.s1368.orig_sentence: As a result of this physical interaction, binding of h-TR beta 1 to its hormone response elements either as homodimer or as a heterodimer with the retinoic X receptor was inhibited by p53 in a concentration-dependent manner.

AIMed.d162.s1369.sentence: In transfected cells, wild-type PROTEIN0 repressed the hormone-dependent transcriptional activation of PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d162.s1369.orig_sentence: In transfected cells, wild-type p53 repressed the hormone-dependent transcriptional activation of h-TR beta 1.

AIMed.d162.s1370.sentence: In contrast, mutant PROTEIN0 either had no effect or activated the transcriptional activity of PROTEIN1 depending on the type of hormone response elements.
AIMed.d162.s1370.orig_sentence: In contrast, mutant p53 either had no effect or activated the transcriptional activity of h-TR beta 1 depending on the type of hormone response elements.

AIMed.d162.s1371.sentence: These results indicate the gene regulating activity of TRs was modulated by PROTEIN0, suggesting that the cross talk between these two transcriptional factors may play an important role in the biology of normal and cancer cells.
AIMed.d162.s1371.orig_sentence: These results indicate the gene regulating activity of TRs was modulated by p53, suggesting that the cross talk between these two transcriptional factors may play an important role in the biology of normal and cancer cells.

AIMed.d163.s1372.sentence: Enhanced degradation of PROTEIN0 receptors by a sorting PROTEIN1, PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d163.s1372.orig_sentence: Enhanced degradation of EGF receptors by a sorting nexin, SNX1.

AIMed.d163.s1373.sentence: The vectorial movement of proteins requires specific recognition by components of the vesicular trafficking machinery.
AIMed.d163.s1373.orig_sentence: The vectorial movement of proteins requires specific recognition by components of the vesicular trafficking machinery.

AIMed.d163.s1374.sentence: A protein, PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1), was identified in a human cell line that bound to a region of the PROTEIN2 (PROTEIN3) containing the lysosomal targeting code.
AIMed.d163.s1374.orig_sentence: A protein, sorting nexin-1 (SNX1), was identified in a human cell line that bound to a region of the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) containing the lysosomal targeting code.

AIMed.d163.s1375.sentence: PROTEIN0 contains a region of homology to a yeast vacuolar sorting protein, and overexpression of PROTEIN1 decreased the amount of PROTEIN2 on the cell surface as a result of enhanced rates of constitutive and ligand-induced degradation.
AIMed.d163.s1375.orig_sentence: SNX1 contains a region of homology to a yeast vacuolar sorting protein, and overexpression of SNX1 decreased the amount of EGFR on the cell surface as a result of enhanced rates of constitutive and ligand-induced degradation.

AIMed.d163.s1376.sentence: Thus, PROTEIN0 is likely to play a role in sorting PROTEIN1 to lysosomes.
AIMed.d163.s1376.orig_sentence: Thus, SNX1 is likely to play a role in sorting EGFR to lysosomes.

AIMed.d164.s1377.sentence: The splicing factor PROTEIN0 mediates critical protein-protein interactions in constitutive and enhancer-dependent splicing.
AIMed.d164.s1377.orig_sentence: The splicing factor U2AF35 mediates critical protein-protein interactions in constitutive and enhancer-dependent splicing.

AIMed.d164.s1378.sentence: The splicing factor U2AF (U2 snRNP auxiliary factor) is a heterodimer with subunits of 65 and 35 kD (PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1).
AIMed.d164.s1378.orig_sentence: The splicing factor U2AF (U2 snRNP auxiliary factor) is a heterodimer with subunits of 65 and 35 kD (U2AF65 and U2AF35).

AIMed.d164.s1379.sentence: PROTEIN0 binds specifically to 3' splice sites, but previous studies failed to demonstrate a function for PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d164.s1379.orig_sentence: U2AF65 binds specifically to 3' splice sites, but previous studies failed to demonstrate a function for U2AF35.

AIMed.d164.s1380.sentence: Here, we report that PROTEIN0 is required for constitutive splicing and also functions as a mediator of enhancer-dependent splicing.
AIMed.d164.s1380.orig_sentence: Here, we report that U2AF35 is required for constitutive splicing and also functions as a mediator of enhancer-dependent splicing.

AIMed.d164.s1381.sentence: Nuclear extracts deficient in PROTEIN0 were inactive; however, both constitutive and enhancer-dependent splicing could be restored by the addition of purified recombinant PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d164.s1381.orig_sentence: Nuclear extracts deficient in U2AF35 were inactive; however, both constitutive and enhancer-dependent splicing could be restored by the addition of purified recombinant U2AF35.

AIMed.d164.s1382.sentence: In vitro protein-RNA interaction studies with pre-mRNAs containing either a constitutive or regulated splicing enhancer revealed that PROTEIN0 directly mediates interactions between PROTEIN1 and proteins bound to the enhancers.
AIMed.d164.s1382.orig_sentence: In vitro protein-RNA interaction studies with pre-mRNAs containing either a constitutive or regulated splicing enhancer revealed that U2AF35 directly mediates interactions between U2AF65 and proteins bound to the enhancers.

AIMed.d164.s1383.sentence: Thus, PROTEIN0 functions as a bridge between PROTEIN1 and the enhancer complex to recruit PROTEIN2 to the adjacent intron.
AIMed.d164.s1383.orig_sentence: Thus, U2AF35 functions as a bridge between U2AF65 and the enhancer complex to recruit U2AF65 to the adjacent intron.

AIMed.d165.s1384.sentence: Interactions involving the human RNA polymerase II transcription/nucleotide excision repair complex PROTEIN0, the nucleotide excision repair protein PROTEIN1, and PROTEIN2 PROTEIN3.
AIMed.d165.s1384.orig_sentence: Interactions involving the human RNA polymerase II transcription/nucleotide excision repair complex TFIIH, the nucleotide excision repair protein XPG, and Cockayne syndrome group B (CSB) protein.

AIMed.d165.s1385.sentence: The human basal transcription factor PROTEIN0 plays a central role in two distinct processes.
AIMed.d165.s1385.orig_sentence: The human basal transcription factor TFIIH plays a central role in two distinct processes.

AIMed.d165.s1386.sentence: PROTEIN0 is an obligatory component of the RNA polymerase II (RNAP II) transcription initiation complex.
AIMed.d165.s1386.orig_sentence: TFIIH is an obligatory component of the RNA polymerase II (RNAP II) transcription initiation complex.

AIMed.d165.s1387.sentence: Additionally, it is believed to be the core structure around which some if not all the components of the nucleotide excision repair (NER) machinery assemble to constitute a nucleotide excision repairosome.
AIMed.d165.s1387.orig_sentence: Additionally, it is believed to be the core structure around which some if not all the components of the nucleotide excision repair (NER) machinery assemble to constitute a nucleotide excision repairosome.

AIMed.d165.s1388.sentence: At least two of the subunits of PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2 proteins) are implicated in the disease xeroderma pigmentosum (XP).
AIMed.d165.s1388.orig_sentence: At least two of the subunits of TFIIH (XPB and XPD proteins) are implicated in the disease xeroderma pigmentosum (XP).

AIMed.d165.s1389.sentence: We have exploited the availability of the cloned PROTEIN0, PROTEIN1, PROTEIN2, PROTEIN3, and PROTEIN4 genes (all of which encode polypeptide subunits of PROTEIN5) to examine interactions between in vitro-translated polypeptides by co-immunoprecipitation.
AIMed.d165.s1389.orig_sentence: We have exploited the availability of the cloned XPB, XPD, p62, p44, and p34 genes (all of which encode polypeptide subunits of TFIIH) to examine interactions between in vitro-translated polypeptides by co-immunoprecipitation.

AIMed.d165.s1390.sentence: Additionally we have examined interactions between PROTEIN0 components, the human NER protein PROTEIN1, and the PROTEIN2 protein which is implicated in Cockayne syndrome (CS).
AIMed.d165.s1390.orig_sentence: Additionally we have examined interactions between TFIIH components, the human NER protein XPG, and the CSB protein which is implicated in Cockayne syndrome (CS).

AIMed.d165.s1391.sentence: Our analyses demonstrate that the PROTEIN0, PROTEIN1, PROTEIN2, and PROTEIN3 proteins interact with each other.
AIMed.d165.s1391.orig_sentence: Our analyses demonstrate that the XPB, XPD, p44, and p62 proteins interact with each other.

AIMed.d165.s1392.sentence: PROTEIN0 protein interacts with multiple subunits of PROTEIN1 and with PROTEIN2 protein.
AIMed.d165.s1392.orig_sentence: XPG protein interacts with multiple subunits of TFIIH and with CSB protein.

AIMed.d166.s1393.sentence: Characterization of the receptor binding sites of human PROTEIN0 and creation of antagonists.
AIMed.d166.s1393.orig_sentence: Characterization of the receptor binding sites of human leukemia inhibitory factor and creation of antagonists.

AIMed.d166.s1394.sentence: Residues in human PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1) crucial for binding to both the human PROTEIN2 (R) and PROTEIN3 were identified by analysis of alanine scanning mutants of PROTEIN4 in assays for both receptor binding and bioactivity.
AIMed.d166.s1394.orig_sentence: Residues in human leukemia inhibitory factor (hLIF) crucial for binding to both the human LIF receptor (R) and gp130 were identified by analysis of alanine scanning mutants of hLIF in assays for both receptor binding and bioactivity.

AIMed.d166.s1395.sentence: The region of PROTEIN0 most important for binding to the PROTEIN1 is composed of residues from the amino terminus of the D-helix, carboxyl terminus of the B-helix, and C-D loop.
AIMed.d166.s1395.orig_sentence: The region of hLIF most important for binding to the hLIF-R is composed of residues from the amino terminus of the D-helix, carboxyl terminus of the B-helix, and C-D loop.

AIMed.d166.s1396.sentence: This site forms a distinct surface at the end of the four-helix bundle in the tertiary structure of the closely related murine PROTEIN0.
AIMed.d166.s1396.orig_sentence: This site forms a distinct surface at the end of the four-helix bundle in the tertiary structure of the closely related murine LIF.

AIMed.d166.s1397.sentence: The two residues of PROTEIN0 that contribute the majority of free energy for PROTEIN1 binding, Phe-156 and Lys-159 are surrounded by other residues which have only a moderate impact.
AIMed.d166.s1397.orig_sentence: The two residues of hLIF that contribute the majority of free energy for hLIF-R binding, Phe-156 and Lys-159 are surrounded by other residues which have only a moderate impact.

AIMed.d166.s1398.sentence: This arrangement of a few key residues surrounded by less important ones is analogous to the functional binding epitope of PROTEIN0 for its receptor.
AIMed.d166.s1398.orig_sentence: This arrangement of a few key residues surrounded by less important ones is analogous to the functional binding epitope of human growth hormone for its receptor.

AIMed.d166.s1399.sentence: A second region of PROTEIN0 that includes residues from the carboxyl terminus of the D-helix and A-B loop also had a weak influence on PROTEIN1 binding.
AIMed.d166.s1399.orig_sentence: A second region of hLIF that includes residues from the carboxyl terminus of the D-helix and A-B loop also had a weak influence on hLIF-R binding.

AIMed.d166.s1400.sentence: Residues in PROTEIN0 from both the A- and C-helices are involved in binding the PROTEIN1 co-receptor.
AIMed.d166.s1400.orig_sentence: Residues in hLIF from both the A- and C-helices are involved in binding the gp130 co-receptor.

AIMed.d166.s1401.sentence: Abolition of the PROTEIN0 binding site in PROTEIN1 created antagonists of PROTEIN2 action.
AIMed.d166.s1401.orig_sentence: Abolition of the gp130 binding site in hLIF created antagonists of LIF action.

AIMed.d167.s1402.sentence: The PROTEIN0 glucose transporter interacts with PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d167.s1402.orig_sentence: The glut 1 glucose transporter interacts with calnexin and calreticulin.

AIMed.d167.s1403.sentence: PROTEIN0 is an integral membrane protein that acts as a chaperone during glycoprotein folding in the endoplasmic reticulum.
AIMed.d167.s1403.orig_sentence: Calnexin is an integral membrane protein that acts as a chaperone during glycoprotein folding in the endoplasmic reticulum.

AIMed.d167.s1404.sentence: Cross-linking studies were carried out with the aim of investigating the interactions of PROTEIN0 with glycoproteins in vitro.
AIMed.d167.s1404.orig_sentence: Cross-linking studies were carried out with the aim of investigating the interactions of calnexin with glycoproteins in vitro.

AIMed.d167.s1405.sentence: A truncated version of the integral membrane glycoprotein PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1) was synthesized in a rabbit reticulocyte translation system in the presence of canine pancreatic microsomes.
AIMed.d167.s1405.orig_sentence: A truncated version of the integral membrane glycoprotein Glut 1 (GT155) was synthesized in a rabbit reticulocyte translation system in the presence of canine pancreatic microsomes.

AIMed.d167.s1406.sentence: Following immunoprecipitation with an anticalnexin antiserum, a cross-linker-independent association was observed between PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d167.s1406.orig_sentence: Following immunoprecipitation with an anticalnexin antiserum, a cross-linker-independent association was observed between GT155 and calnexin.

AIMed.d167.s1407.sentence: In addition, the anti-calnexin antiserum immunoprecipitated a UV-dependent cross-linking product consisting of PROTEIN0 and a protein of approximately 60 kDa designated PROTEIN1 (PROTEIN2 of 60 kDa).
AIMed.d167.s1407.orig_sentence: In addition, the anti-calnexin antiserum immunoprecipitated a UV-dependent cross-linking product consisting of GT155 and a protein of approximately 60 kDa designated CAP-60 (calnexin-associated protein of 60 kDa).

AIMed.d167.s1408.sentence: Both the PROTEIN0-PROTEIN1 and the PROTEIN2-PROTEIN3 interactions were dependent on the presence of a correctly modified oligosaccharide group on PROTEIN4, a characteristic of many PROTEIN5 interactions.
AIMed.d167.s1408.orig_sentence: Both the GT155-calnexin and the GT155-CAP-60 interactions were dependent on the presence of a correctly modified oligosaccharide group on GT155, a characteristic of many calnexin interactions.

AIMed.d167.s1409.sentence: A PROTEIN0 mutant that was not glycosylated (AGGT155) did not associate with PROTEIN1 or PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d167.s1409.orig_sentence: A GT155 mutant that was not glycosylated (AGGT155) did not associate with calnexin or CAP-60.

AIMed.d167.s1410.sentence: PROTEIN0, the soluble homologue of PROTEIN1, was also shown to interact with PROTEIN2 only when the protein bore a correctly modified oligosaccharide group.
AIMed.d167.s1410.orig_sentence: Calreticulin, the soluble homologue of calnexin, was also shown to interact with GT155 only when the protein bore a correctly modified oligosaccharide group.

AIMed.d167.s1411.sentence: Thus, our data show that both PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 interact with PROTEIN2 in a glycosylation-dependent manner.
AIMed.d167.s1411.orig_sentence: Thus, our data show that both calnexin and calreticulin interact with Glut 1 in a glycosylation-dependent manner.

AIMed.d168.s1412.sentence: Identification of a critical ligand binding determinant of the human PROTEIN0 PROTEIN1. Evidence for common ligand binding motifs in the cytokine receptor family.
AIMed.d168.s1412.orig_sentence: Identification of a critical ligand binding determinant of the human erythropoietin receptor. Evidence for common ligand binding motifs in the cytokine receptor family.

AIMed.d168.s1413.sentence: The PROTEIN0 PROTEIN1 (PROTEIN2) is a member of a family of cytokine and growth factor receptors that share conserved features in their extracellular and cytoplasmic domains.
AIMed.d168.s1413.orig_sentence: The erythropoietin receptor (EPOR) is a member of a family of cytokine and growth factor receptors that share conserved features in their extracellular and cytoplasmic domains.

AIMed.d168.s1414.sentence: We have used site-specific mutagenesis within the extracellular domain of the PROTEIN0 to search for amino acid residues involved in PROTEIN1 (PROTEIN2) binding.
AIMed.d168.s1414.orig_sentence: We have used site-specific mutagenesis within the extracellular domain of the EPOR to search for amino acid residues involved in erythropoietin (EPO) binding.

AIMed.d168.s1415.sentence: Mutant proteins were expressed in bacteria as soluble PROTEIN0 binding proteins (PROTEIN1) and characterized for PROTEIN2 binding activity in a number of different assays.
AIMed.d168.s1415.orig_sentence: Mutant proteins were expressed in bacteria as soluble EPO binding proteins (EBP) and characterized for EPO binding activity in a number of different assays.

AIMed.d168.s1416.sentence: Substitution of phenylalanine at position 93 (Phe93) with alanine (F93A mutation) resulted in a drastic reduction in PROTEIN0 binding in the PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d168.s1416.orig_sentence: Substitution of phenylalanine at position 93 (Phe93) with alanine (F93A mutation) resulted in a drastic reduction in EPO binding in the EBP.

AIMed.d168.s1417.sentence: More conservative tyrosine or tryptophan substitutions at Phe93 resulted in much less dramatic effects on PROTEIN0 binding.

AIMed.d183.s1556.orig_sentence: Under these conditions, a ternary complex of p21ras, JAK2, and Raf-1 was observed.

AIMed.d183.s1558.sentence: In addition, PROTEIN0 phosphorylated PROTEIN1 at sites different from those phosphorylated by PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d183.s1558.orig_sentence: In addition, JAK2 phosphorylated Raf-1 at sites different from those phosphorylated by pp60v-src.

AIMed.d183.s1559.sentence: In mammalian cells treated with either erythropoietin or interferon-gamma, a small fraction of PROTEIN0 coimmunoprecipitated with PROTEIN1 in lysates of cells in which PROTEIN2 was activated as judged by its state of tyrosine phosphorylation.
AIMed.d183.s1559.orig_sentence: In mammalian cells treated with either erythropoietin or interferon-gamma, a small fraction of Raf-1 coimmunoprecipitated with JAK2 in lysates of cells in which JAK2 was activated as judged by its state of tyrosine phosphorylation.

AIMed.d183.s1560.sentence: Taken together, these data suggest that PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 cooperate to activate PROTEIN2.
AIMed.d183.s1560.orig_sentence: Taken together, these data suggest that JAK2 and p21ras cooperate to activate Raf-1.

AIMed.d185.s1574.sentence: Using a structure-function mutagenesis approach, two tyrosine residues (Tyr427 and Tyr477) in the intracellular domain of the murine PROTEIN0 PROTEIN1 were found to be redundantly required for receptor function and for activation of PROTEIN2 but not for PROTEIN3 or Stat5.
